4b8e88ab.title: Lead Managed Services Consultant
4b8e88ab.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 Lead managed services delivery for Sprinklr Community customers by owning the strategy, architecture, governance, and evolution of customer community platforms. Drive community transformation initiatives, user experience optimization, platform adoption, and operational excellence while serving as the primary advisor to customers on community best practices, digital engagement, and platform roadmap execution.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end management and optimization of Sprinklr Community platforms, ensuring scalability, performance, governance, and business alignment.
* Design and oversee community architecture including forums, discussion boards, knowledge communities, user journeys, moderation frameworks, gamification, and engagement models.
* Act as the primary strategic advisor for customer community initiatives, providing recommendations on platform adoption, engagement growth, governance, and operational maturity.
* Drive requirements discovery, solution design, roadmap planning, and execution of community enhancement programs.
* Define and implement community governance frameworks including roles, permissions, moderation strategies, content lifecycle management, and user access controls.
* Lead root cause analysis and resolution of complex platform, workflow, configuration, and user experience issues.
* Own community analytics, adoption reporting, engagement insights, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Provide leadership and guidance to consultants and technical teams supporting community operations and managed services delivery.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and customer leadership teams to ensure successful outcomes and long\-term platform value realization.
* Lead release management, platform audits, health checks, optimization reviews, and best practice assessments.
* Oversee UI/UX strategy and front\-end customization initiatives to deliver intuitive, accessible, and engaging community experiences.
* Provide architectural guidance on API integrations, SSO, CRM connectivity, and third\-party ecosystem integrations.
* Establish reusable governance models, operational playbooks, implementation standards, and community best practices.


**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**
* 8\-12 years of experience in Community Platforms, Digital Experience Platforms, Managed Services, SaaS Consulting, or Customer Engagement solutions.
* Deep hands\-on experience with Sprinklr Community or similar platforms such as Khoros, Gainsight, Salesforce Experience Cloud, Higher Logic, or Enterprise Community solutions.
* Proven experience designing, building, launching, and managing large\-scale customer community portals and online forums.
* Strong expertise in community architecture, moderation frameworks, engagement strategies, governance models, and digital customer experiences.
* Advanced knowledge of UI/UX principles, information architecture, user journey design, accessibility, and community experience optimization.
* Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive design principles, and front\-end customization approaches.
* High\-level understanding of REST APIs, authentication models, SSO, webhooks, integrations, and enterprise system connectivity.
* Experience leading customer workshops, solution design sessions, governance reviews, and executive stakeholder discussions.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, consulting, and customer management capabilities.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Experience with customer support communities, brand advocacy programs, knowledge communities, or peer\-to\-peer support ecosystems.
* Exposure to SEO, search optimization, content strategy, and digital engagement best practices.
* Understanding of CRM platforms, customer support ecosystems, and customer experience technologies.
* Experience managing globally distributed communities and enterprise\-scale engagement programs.
* Program management and service delivery leadership experience within managed services organizations.


**Who You Are**
* A strategic consultant with deep expertise in customer communities and digital engagement platforms.
* Passionate about building world\-class community experiences that drive adoption, engagement, and business outcomes.
* Comfortable engaging with both executive stakeholders and technical teams.
* A thought leader who combines consulting, technical, operational, and design expertise to deliver customer success.
* Driven by continuous improvement, innovation, and long\-term customer value realization.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Highly engaged, scalable, and well\-governed customer communities.
* Strong customer satisfaction, adoption, and business value realization.
* Successful execution of strategic community transformation and optimization initiatives.
* Improved user experience, engagement metrics, and operational efficiency.
* Trusted advisor status with customer leadership and key stakeholders.
* Consistent delivery of managed services KPIs, governance objectives, and platform growth outcomes.


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

8ccbc72e.title: ServiceNow Solutions Manager (Pre-Sales)
8ccbc72e.description:
**Overview**
 Prodapt is seeking a ServiceNow Solutions Manager to be based in one of our India offices. You'll shape ServiceNow\-based, AI\-led solutions spanning our workflows \- combining deep telecom\-native (TMT) expertise with our agentic AI capabilities, and extending this solutioning approach to adjacent, non\-telco industries as Prodapt's portfolio grows \- that power our sales, alliances, and product development initiatives. The role is focused on architecting proposals, and providing technical solutioning during the sales cycle, with a strong emphasis on applying AI and agentic AI methodologies to ServiceNow solution design. This role requires 8\-10 years of relevant ServiceNow experience, hands\-on exposure to AI\-led solution design, and strong pre\-sales solutioning skills
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with sales and alliances teams to architect ServiceNow\-based, AI\-led solutions across the entire TMT stack and adjacent non\-telco industries for prospective deals, RFPs, and RFIs
* Provide pre\-sales technical guidance across the Now Platform, including designing AI and agentic AI\-based methodologies to support deal qualification and positioning
* Deliver solution proposals, demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and technical presentations spotlighting Prodapt's agentic AI stack to prospects, partners, and internal stakeholders across telecom and other industry verticals
* Partner with the CTO Office to stay current on the ServiceNow platform roadmap, translating new capabilities into sales\-ready solution narratives for TMT and non\-telco engagements alike
* Support competitive positioning, scoping, and pricing inputs during the sales cycle
* Act as the technical point of contact between sales, alliances, and product teams during the pre\-sales phase, handing off solution designs\- to delivery teams, post\-sale
* Contribute to building reusable ServiceNow solution accelerators, reference architectures, and best practices that can be applied across TMT and non\-telco industry verticals


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or engineering
* 8\-10\+ years of ServiceNow experience, with a solid pre\-sales /solutioning background
* Familiarity with telecom\-specific ServiceNow modules (TMT) and TM Forum/MEF\-aligned solutions, along with the versatility to extend ServiceNow AI\-led solutioning approaches to non\-telco industries (media, technology, and other enterprise verticals)
* Hands\-on experience applying AI/GenAI solution design methodologies \- agentic workflow design, prompt engineering, and use\-case discovery \- to ServiceNow solutioning, along with a working understanding of how AI responses are grounded in enterprise data
* Hands\-on working knowledge of ServiceNow's agentic AI stack \- Now Assist, AI Agent Studio, Context Engine, AI Control Tower, RaptorDB Pro, and Now Platform SDK/Build Agent \- with the ability to design, configure, and demo solutions built on these capabilities
* ServiceNow certifications \- CSA, CIS and/or CTA are preferred
* Strong presentation and demo skills; ability to translate technical capabilities into business value for prospects and stakeholders

cf02f278.title: Sr. Solutions Architect/Senior Enterprise Integration Architect - Finance Systems
cf02f278.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**



At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We're helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It's an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one\-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi\-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world's most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.


**THE TEAM \& ROLE**



Zuora's Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company\-wide. Taking a cloud\-first, AI\-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self\-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility \- all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.



Within Corporate Operations, the G\&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General \& Administrative functions, including Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.



The Sr, Solutions Architect \- Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise\-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross\-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).



You'll join a collaborative, high\-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora's enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.


**YOUR MISSION**



As a senior technical anchor supporting all G\&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect \- Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting\-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.


**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**



As the Sr, Solutions Architect \- Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi\-platform integration specialist, you'll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross\-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You'll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.



Key responsibilities include:


* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross\-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end\-to\-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G\&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high\-performing API\-based integrations, microservices, and file\-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2\.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI\-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field\-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).


**OUR TECH STACK:** REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2\.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.

  


### **WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH**


* **Deliver Modern Data Architecture**: Transition fragmented cross\-system data points from disparate G\&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* **Excellence in System Integrations**: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* **Next\-Gen Tech Adoption:** Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self\-service models.
* **Advance Automation \& Data Reliability:** Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end\-to\-end business workflows.
* **Promote Secure \& Compliant Operations:** Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field\-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* **Establish Sustainable System Practices**: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long\-term scalability and consistent cross\-functional operational excellence.


**WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8\+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands\-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G\&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross\-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross\-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.


**\#ZEOLife at Zuora**



As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly—it's exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as "ZEOs" are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we're making what's next possible for our customers, community and the world.



As part of our commitment to building an inclusive, high\-performance culture where ZEOs feel inspired, connected and valued, we support ZEOs with:



Competitive compensation, corporate bonus program and performance rewards, company equity and retirement programs



Medical, dental and vision insurance



Generous, flexible time off



Paid holidays, "wellness" days and company wide end of year break



Learning \& Development stipend



Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation match



Free resources and support for your mental wellbeing


* Specific benefits offerings may vary by country and can be viewed in more detail during your interview process.



Location \& Work Arrangements



Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. In our dynamic, globally distributed company, this means balancing flexibility and responsibility — flexibility to live our lives to the fullest, and responsibility to each other, to our customers, and to our shareholders. For most roles, we offer the flexibility to work both remotely and at Zuora offices.



Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace



Think, be and do you! At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.



Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.



We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.
**Senior Staff SAP S/4 Analytics Architect**
============================================

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We are seeking an experienced Senior Staff SAP S/4 Analytics Architect to establish and scale our SAP S/4 Embedded Analytics capability. This **hands\-on architecture** role defines the platform, governance, and delivery standards that enable secure, scalable, high\-quality operational analytics aligned with SAP Clean Core principles.
  

  

Starting as the primary report developer, the architect will build the foundation for success by creating reusable Virtual Data Models (VDMs), CDS standards, reference implementations, governance processes, architecture reviews, transport and release controls, security standards, and development best practices.
  

  

The role will establish and enable the SAP Embedded Analytics Expert capability through mentoring, reusable assets, templates, and technical guidance. By leading through hands\-on implementation and reference solutions, the architect will enable a guided self\-service analytics model that accelerates report delivery while maintaining architectural guardrails, governance, and solution quality.
  

  

The architect will also modernize legacy reporting by driving the transition from SQ01 and custom reports to SAP S/4 Embedded Analytics using standard SAP Fiori analytical applications, CDS Views, and reusable analytical models. Success will be measured by a sustainable analytics platform, strong governance, faster report delivery, and an empowered Analytics Expert community.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Support the SAP S/4 Embedded Analytics architecture, roadmap, standards, and governance.
* Lead modernization of SQ01 and legacy reporting.
* Design reusable CDS Views, VDMs, Analytical Queries, KPIs, and Fiori analytical applications.
* Develop reusable templates, accelerators, and reference implementations.
* Establish architecture reviews, code reviews, testing, transport, security, and release governance.
* Build and mentor the SAP Embedded Analytics Expert community and establish an Analytics Center of Excellence.
* Enable guided self\-service analytics while ensuring SAP Clean Core compliance.
* Partner with business process owners across major SAP domains.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 10\+ years of SAP analytics experience with multiple SAP S/4HANA implementations.
* Proven hands\-on implementation of SAP S/4 Embedded Analytics in at least one end\-to\-end SAP S/4 transformation.
* Expertise in ABAP CDS Views, VDMs, CDS Extensions, Analytical Queries and Fiori analytical applications
* Experience implementing analytics governance, architecture reviews, transport management, and operating models.
* Experience activating standard SAP analytics, replacing SQ01, and building reusable frameworks and Centers of Excellence.
* Strong end\-to\-end SAP business process knowledge and excellent stakeholder management.

**First 12 Months – Expected Outcomes**
---------------------------------------

* Establish governance, standards, templates, and reference architectures.
* Launch the SAP Embedded Analytics Expert enablement program.
* Deliver reusable CDS assets
* Implement review, transport, and quality processes.
* Enable the first wave of guided self\-service analytics.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

* Enterprise adoption of SAP S/4 Embedded Analytics.
* Retire SQ01 and reduce custom reporting.
* Faster report delivery through guided self\-service analytics.
* High reuse of standard SAP content and CDS assets.
Consistent governance and a self\-sustaining Analytics Expert community.

602e2d76.description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
   

  

 Core Brokerage Services Engineering (CBSE) enables Schwab to fulfill its custodial and clearing obligations as a Broker\-Dealer and enables clients to invest strategically and achieve their financial goals. The Solutions Architect is a key technical leader in the CBSE organization, ensuring that Schwab India software development and engineering teams coalesce with established and evolving technology governance, standards, practices, and strategy as well as regulatory standards and requirements. This role requires a strong background in leading end\-to\-end architecture direction for high\-volume heterogenous technology platforms as well as hands\-on experience throughout the software development lifecycle. It’s an exciting time to join CBSE as it endeavors to modernize its platforms while incrementally delivering new features and capabilities to Schwab’s clients and growing businesses.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Collaborate with peer platform architects, enterprise architects, and software development and engineering teams to develop and maintain cohesive current and target state software architecture documents and reference implementations.
* Balance long\-term thinking with crafting architecture increments that deliver business value near\-term, guiding technical leads in creating these designs.
* Mentor software developers and engineers to leverage established patterns and software engineering best practices and adhere to policies and standards.
* Champion end\-to\-end observability, monitoring and alerting, adherence to service level indicators and objectives, and operational excellence (24x7 availability).
* Identify and address scalability, latency, resiliency, and performance improvement opportunities.
* Lead architecture strategy sessions and engage hands\-on throughout the software delivery lifecycle to resolve challenges.
* Remain informed on industry trends in financial technology and apply this knowledge to drive innovation within the organization.


 What you have
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
* 15\+ years of hands\-on full stack software development experience across diverse technologies such as .NET/C\#, Java/Spring framework, COBOL, Python, RabbitMQ/Kafka/IBM MQ, SOAP/REST services, and modern front\-end frameworks like Angular/React.
* Knowledge of both SQL (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Cloud SQL, DB2\) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Aerospike) with extensive experience in designing and optimizing data solutions.
* 5\+ years hands\-on expertise architecting, designing and integrating components, and implementing large\-scale solutions
* Experience architecting and building private and public cloud\-based or cloud\-ready applications (e.g., PCF, GCP).
* Proven ability to handle fast\-paced agile delivery environment, prioritize competing deadlines, and contribute to multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, demonstrable ability to help others visualize application design and system integration patterns.
* Demonstratable proficiency in business analysis, problem\-solving, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in the financial services industry.
* Proven ability to build interpersonal relationships with various roles and garner fellowship.
* Ability to quickly grasp complex concepts and learn new technologies.
* Experience with AI and LLMs (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot).
* Working proficiency with software configuration management and continuous integration and delivery concepts and tools (e.g., Remedy, ChangeMan, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Bamboo, Jenkins).
* Experience supporting production operations and providing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) expertise.
* Strong client focus and sense of ownership.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Education assistance for continued learning to help you grow
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

a97e1637.description:
Responsible for leading the development of comprehensive solution architecture strategies, ensuring seamless integration of application solutions across teams and domains while maintaining robust technical foundations. The role involves collaboration with other architects to validate feasibility, oversee compliance with quality attributes, manage technical risks, and guide IT architects to enhance their solution architecture leadership skills, all while aligning with FedEx best practices and technological standards.
   

  

* Lead and define solution architecture strategies, encompassing technology and architecture for seamless integration of application solutions across various teams and domains.
* Establish and maintain the architectural runway at a solution level, ensuring a robust technical foundation for the rapid and reliable creation of new functionalities and features across teams and ARTs.
* Collaborate with other architects to validate the feasibility and sustainability of solution architectures and application portfolio lifecycle planning, ensuring alignment with FedEx best practices and design standards.
* Oversee the management of non\-functional requirements and compliance to ensure that solution architectures meet essential quality attributes such as performance, scalability, security, and maintainability, meeting stakeholder acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with other architects to define the appropriate delivery approach for solution services, encompassing processes, methodologies, tooling, and partnerships for agreement on service design and delivery.
* Identify and manage technical risks and continuous improvement opportunities for solution architectures, leveraging expert business knowledge to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
* Continuously monitor and evaluate new or emerging technologies utilized by internal teams, ensuring alignment with FedEx technological standards and potential integration into solution architectures.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to other IT architects to develop their skills and expertise in solution architecture leadership and execution.


 Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems and/or equivalent formal training or work experience. Relevant Master’s degree, TOGAF certification and SAFe Agile certification strongly preferred.
   

  

 Experience: Eight (8\) years equivalent work experience in information technology or engineering environment with a direct responsibility for strategy formulation and solution/technical architecture, as well as designing, architecting, developing, implementing and monitoring efficient and effective solutions to diverse and complex business problems.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Fluency in English
* Accuracy \& Attention to Detail
* Influencing \& Persuasion
* Planning \& Organizing
* Problem Solving
* Project Management

**Pay**

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. 879aa6dd.title: Solution Architecture - Copilot
879aa6dd.description:
**Overview**
 The Architect role in Solution Architecture involves gathering insights about client business and technical requirements to propose viable solutions based on Microsoft technologies. The role includes acting as a customer advocate, leveraging existing architecture approaches, and applying technical knowledge to meet clients' needs and resolve technical constraints. Architects assess and build clients' technical capabilities, lead technical activities for building solutions, and support pre\-sales, post\-sales, and implementation for client projects. They contribute to the design, build, and deployment of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, applying methodology and governance to minimize risks and manage quality assurance. Additionally, they act as trusted advisors by building relationships, challenging others, and demonstrating Microsoft's value proposition.
   

  

 The role includes various levels, from IC2 to IC6, each with increasing responsibilities and expertise. For example, IC2 focuses on learning and supporting colleagues, while IC6 involves leading the adoption of Microsoft solutions technologies and developing a deep network of relationships with senior\-level decision makers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Architect job description includes several key responsibilities and roles:
   

  

* Gathering Insights: Solution Architects gather insights about client business and technical requirements to propose viable solutions based on Microsoft technologies. They act as customer advocates and share insights with internal teams to better meet customer/partner needs.
* Architecture Design and Deployment: They leverage existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft’s agreed commitments to customers/partners. They apply technical knowledge of architecture solutions to meet clients’ business and technical requirements and resolve technical constraints and blockers.
* Building Technical Capabilities: Solution Architects assess, enable, and build clients' technical capabilities. They lead technical activities for building solutions and support pre\-sales, post\-sales, and implementation for client projects.
* Proof of Concepts (POCs) and Pilots: They contribute to the design, build, and deployment of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. They apply methodology and governance to minimize risks and manage quality assurance.
* Trusted Advisor: Solution Architects act as trusted advisors by building relationships, challenging others, and demonstrating Microsoft’s differentiated value proposition.
* Delivery Sponsor: This role may serve as a delivery sponsor for a select number of assigned customers, demonstrating full accountability for portfolio, account, customer relationship, and financial management in presales and delivery.
* Continuous Learning: Architects demonstrate the ability to learn new technologies based on business demands and industry trends.
* Deep Product Knowledge and Extensive Implementation Experience: The Architect for AI Business Solutions will require deep product knowledge and skills in Business Applications, Modern Work, Copilot and Agentic solutions, and extensive experience implementing Business Applications and Modern Work solutions, and AI leveraging Copilot and Agentic solutions.


**Qualifications**
 The Architect qualifications include several key skills and capabilities:
   

  

**Architecting Impactful Solutions**
* Architecture Design: The ability to apply reference architecture and patterns for a variety of solutions (e.g., advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, big data, Internet of Things, modern business intelligence and analytics, modern applications, data platform modernization, data warehousing, business intelligence and analytics, etc.).
* Artificial Intelligence (AI): Knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and their applications.
* Cloud Security: The ability to explain and advise on cloud security considerations, capabilities, and tools across software as a service (SaaS), platform as a service (PaaS), and infrastructure as a service (IaaS).
* Engineering Skills: The ability to understand and analyse the software and hardware components of programs. This includes the ability to engineer, reverse engineer, test, and analyse inventions and products.
* Network Architecture: Knowledge of the framework for the specification of a network's physical components and their functional organization and configuration, its operational principles and procedures, as well as communication protocols used.
* Security Principles: The ability to follow secure\-by\-design principles to ensure a secure foundation in the design of solutions.
* Software Architecture: Knowledge of the high\-level structures of a software system and the principles of creating such structures and systems.
* Software Engineering Practices: The ability to apply software engineering principles, including application architecture, software development, and coding skills to deploy customer solutions.


**Driving Effective Stakeholder Partnerships**
* Conflict Resolution: The ability to manage conflict, disharmony, and strife among people and situations, while recognizing and addressing sensitivities.
* Executive Relationships: The ability to interact confidently with senior leaders of the organization to present/defend/clarify concerns or issues regarding an existing project, program, or solution.
* Negotiation: The ability to achieve mutually satisfying agreements in negotiations with others by listening to their objectives, acting as the company's representative to effectively communicate the company's objective, and seeking common ground and collaborative solutions.
* Business Relationship Management: The ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with supervisors, staff, managers, customers, and vendors.
* Stakeholder Management: The ability to manage project stakeholders and stakeholder engagements.
* Team Facilitation: The ability to lead and orchestrate cross\-functional teams to complete objectives.
* Technical Communication: The ability to adapt communications around different technologies, products, and services to the audience's level of understanding.
* Trusted Advisor: The ability to build trusted advisor status and deep relationships across stakeholders (e.g., technical decision makers, business decision makers) through an understanding of customer needs and technologies.


**Industry Leading Business And Industry Knowledge**
* Business Analysis: The ability to identify business needs and determine solutions to business problems.
* Business Knowledge: The ability to appreciate the technical nature of the business, as well as how a particular function relates to that industry and the competition.
* Commercial Technology Acumen: Knowledge of the business drivers behind technology.
* Competitive Analysis: The ability to identify competitors and evaluate their respective strengths and weaknesses.
* Migration Planning: The ability to lead customer conversations on competitive cloud differentiation in compelling customer terms.
* Technology Industry Knowledge: Knowledge of trends, direction, new products, and changes in the technology as it applies to a particular area of focus.


**Leveraging Data Insights To Meet Business Needs**
* Data Analysis: The ability to systematically gather information from a variety of sources, analyse information, identify implications of data, draw conclusions, generate alternatives and solutions, and evaluate the consequences of choosing each alternative using quality metrics and data.
* Data Architecture: Knowledge of Data Architecture, the process and the outcome of analysing the overall structure and the logical interrelationships of how data fits together throughout the organization.
* Databases: Knowledge of data platform modernization and data warehouse capabilities.
* Decision Making: The ability to make decisions in a fast\-paced, rapidly changing environment.


**Managing Projects To Ensure Quality**
* Governance Methodology and Practices: Knowledge of established governance methodology, policies, procedures, and practices.
* Operational Excellence: The ability to apply principles, systems, tools, and strategic insights to sustainably improve key performance metrics (KPIs) and drive operational efficiencies.
* Project Management: Knowledge of and the ability to carry out the process of planning, organizing, and managing tasks and resources to accomplish a well\-defined objective.
* Quality Assurance: Knowledge of and the ability to follow systematic and continuing processes of checking to see whether a product, service, or process is meeting specified requirements.
* Strategic Technical Planning: The ability to map the company's products and solutions to customer modernization and digital transformation plans to drive business outcomes.


**Maximizing Microsoft Value To Business**
* Cloud Platform: Knowledge of the cloud platform, productivity platform, identity, and multi\-geography deployment strategy.
* Consultative Selling: The ability to understand customer needs through dialogue before recommending products/services.
* Creativity: The ability to apply ingenuity, inventiveness, and imagination to the inclusive design and construction of a product, service, program, or initiative.
* Driving Insight\-Led Conversations: The ability to bring a differentiated, tailored point of view to customer or partner conversations that create a valuable purchase experience for the customer/partner.
* Innovation \& Capability Growth: The ability to apply and encourage an innovative point of view during client interactions to identify new opportunities and grow client capabilities.
* Microsoft Products: Knowledge of Microsoft products/services and the ability to participate in technical conversations related to products/services.
* Storytelling: The ability to sell and communicate value within and outside the company by sharing stories and historical anecdotes.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
 **requesting accommodations.**

0149226c.description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced End\-to\-End Solution Architect to lead the design of complex, high\-value customer solutions across the VOIS organisation. This role focuses on large, multi\-tower opportunities, bringing together technology, business, care and corporate services into compelling, commercially sound propositions. The individual will work closely with customers up to CxO level, sales teams, service towers and delivery leaders to ensure solutions are differentiated, deliverable, and profitable.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end solution definition for large, complex opportunities (typically exceeding €5m contract value) across multiple service towers and service units

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

R0137676

HITACHI ENERGY TECHNOLOGY SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED

Full time

No
**Job Description:**

**The opportunity**

At Hitachi Energy, we are accelerating our digital transformation journey by optimizing and modernizing global transportation and logistics operations. As a SAP TM Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in defining, designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise\-wide transportation management solutions that enable efficient, scalable, and intelligent logistics processes across our global business landscape.


In this role, you will combine transportation management expertise, solution architecture leadership, and emerging technologies such as SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive innovation and operational excellence. You will lead SAP TM transformation initiatives, define strategic roadmaps, and deliver robust, integrated logistics solutions aligned with business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.


**How you'll make an impact**

* Define and govern the SAP TM solution architecture strategy, standards, and roadmap across global business functions.
* Design scalable, standardized, and best\-practice transportation management processes that support global logistics operations.
* Ensure solution alignment with enterprise architecture principles, cybersecurity requirements, compliance regulations, and digital transformation objectives.
* Lead architecture reviews, solution governance forums, and technical decision\-making processes.
* Design and optimize SAP TM capabilities including Freight Unit Building, Transportation Planning, Load Planning and Optimization, Carrier Selection, Freight Order Management, Transportation Execution, Freight Settlement, Cost Allocation, Charge Management, Logistics Visibility, and Event Tracking.
* Drive global standardization and harmonization of transportation management processes and solutions.
* Provide technical leadership for SAP TM solution development and architecture.
* Review and approve technical designs, enhancements, custom developments, and solution integrations.
* Deliver expertise in ABAP OO, BOPF Framework, FPM Applications, CDS Views, OData Services, APIs, Enhancement Framework, Workflow, and BRF\+.
* Architect SAP BTP\-based extensions, integrations, and cloud\-native transportation management solutions.
* Evaluate and implement innovative technologies and digital capabilities that improve transportation planning, visibility, and execution.
* Enable event\-driven and API\-based architectures to support modern business processes and integrations.
* Define and lead AI\-enabled transportation optimization strategies.
* Evaluate AI and machine learning use cases including route optimization, shipment consolidation, predictive freight planning, load planning optimization, transportation exception management, and logistics cost optimization.
* Support the integration of AI services within SAP solutions and external platforms.
* Lead adoption and integration of SAP Business Network for Logistics (BN4L), including carrier collaboration, freight tendering, shipment tracking, and logistics visibility capabilities.
* Strengthen collaboration with carriers, freight forwarders, logistics providers, and external business partners.
* Define end\-to\-end integration architecture between SAP TM and connected systems, including SAP S/4HANA, SAP EWM, SAP GTS, SAP BTP, BN4L, third\-party logistics providers, and external carrier platforms.
* Ensure reliable, scalable, and secure integrations using APIs, IDocs, events, middleware technologies, and SAP Integration Suite.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical SAP TM issues and support complex incident resolution activities.
* Conduct root cause analysis, provide solution recommendations, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Mentor and guide functional consultants, developers, and project teams to build organizational capability and best practices.

**Your background**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of SAP experience, with at least 7 years of hands\-on expertise in SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM).
* Proven experience as an SAP TM Solution Architect within complex global organizations.
* Strong expertise in transportation management, logistics operations, freight management, and supply chain processes.
* Experience delivering global SAP implementation, transformation, and rollout programs.
* Deep knowledge of SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM) and SAP S/4HANA TM.
* Experience with SAP Business Network for Logistics (BN4L), SAP BTP, SAP EWM, and SAP GTS.
* Strong technical architecture knowledge covering ABAP OO, BOPF, FPM, CDS Views, OData Services, APIs, BRF\+, Enhancement Framework, and SAP Integration Suite.
* Experience with RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model) is preferred.
* Strong understanding of cloud\-based architectures, integration patterns, and event\-driven solutions.
* Familiarity with AI and machine learning applications in transportation and logistics domains is highly desirable.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem\-solving, decision\-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-functional, and multicultural environment.
**Accessibility and reasonable accommodation**

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

  

**This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.**

These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision\-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.**

These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.**

3ea1dd04.title: Principal Solutions Consultant — Managed Services (APAC)
3ea1dd04.description:
**About the Company**  

Keka is a SaaS HRMS platform, helping companies manage the entire employee lifecycle efficiently– hiring, onboarding, time \& attendance, payroll, performance, and learning in one integrated system.
We have been in the market for 10\+ years and currently serve around ten thousand clients in India, US and GCC. **Context**  

Keka is standing up its Managed Services (MS) business. MS is not a BPO — it is Keka running the customer's payroll, statutory, and HR operations on the Keka HRMS platform they already have (or would move to). Same platform, same data, same employee experience, new operating model.
This role covers the APAC region — primarily Philippines, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, Malaysia, and Indonesia. Where deals extend into Middle East or Europe, you carry the technical narrative there as well. **About the Role** **Solutioning is your primary responsibility.** You are the APAC country expert who owns Payroll / Statutory / Time \& Attendance depth for the market. You sit in prospect calls, create need for MS, defend and shape scope, and push deals through to closure. You are not a passive expert — you carry the deal.
Beyond Solutioning, you partner across three functions to make sure the motion holds together: GTM (support and enable Sales), Product (bridge to R\&D on functional gaps), and Delivery (track project health post\-signature). You do not execute delivery or own partnerships — those live elsewhere. Your job is to close deals and make sure closed deals stay healthy. **Primary Responsibility \- Solutioning** **Country Expertise*** **Statutory framework depth.** Philippines (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag\-IBIG, BIR, 13th month, service incentive leave), Singapore (CPF, IRAS, SDL), Australia (ATO STP Phase 2, superannuation, PAYG), New Zealand (IRD, KiwiSaver), Malaysia (EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB), Hong Kong (MPF, IRD), Indonesia (BPJS, PPh 21\). Regional peculiarities: 13th\-month pay, gratuity variants, non\-resident tax withholding, cross\-border employment.
* **Payroll components.** Gross\-to\-net mechanics, salary structures, reimbursements, garnishments, F\&F settlements, prior\-vendor cleanup patterns.
* **Time \& Attendance.** Attendance\-to\-payroll pipelines, overtime rules, PTO / leave policy design, statutory paid leave.
* **Compliance rhythm.** Notice triage cadence, audit prep, peak\-load moments (year\-end, statutory season) that customers panic about.

 **Sales\-Call presence*** **Create need.** Walk a prospect through their own pain in ways they had not articulated. Turn "we already do payroll" into "we already lose Ops leaders to payroll."
* **Defend and shape scope.** Hold the SKU line where it matters; concede where it wins the deal. Know the difference cold.
* **Carry the technical narrative from first\-call to signed MSA.** RFP responses, security questionnaires, statutory Q\&A, delivery walk\-throughs.
* **Competitive positioning.** Displacement plays against Deel, Papaya Global, Remote, Multiplier, Rippling APAC, Neeyamo APAC, and regional incumbents (JustLogin in SGP, HR2Eazy in MY, Sprout in PH, ELMO / Employment Hero in AU) — know each competitor's weak spots cold.

 **Secondary Responsibilities** **GTM \- Support and enable*** Enable Sales (Farming \+ Hunting) with talk tracks, objection handling, and country\-specific scope walkthroughs — delivered via the Enablement team.
* Contribute to MS content the Marketing team produces: pitch decks, scope\-by\-SKU 2\-pagers, displacement battlecards, case studies. Ensure the content is factually correct and prospect\-tested.
* Feed back what is landing and what is not from prospect calls, so content and positioning evolve on a fast cadence.

 **Product \- bridge, not build*** Translate recurring prospect and delivery pain into structured Product requirements (not anecdotes).
* Track those requirements through Product's roadmap. When a Product gap blocks an MS deal, pull it forward with a data\-backed case.
* When Product ships something useful, get it into pitch decks and battlecards within a week.

 **Delivery \- track, not execute*** Monitor delivery health on the accounts you closed — cycle accuracy, SLA adherence, escalations, renewal signals.
* Flag risks to Delivery leads early; hand off cleanly and stay available as escalation backup.
* Own the debrief when a deal closes — what did we sell, what does Delivery need to deliver, where are the known risks.

 **What you bring*** **Deep payroll expertise for APAC.** You can walk any prospect through statutory framework, filing calendars, and edge cases without notes.
* **6\+ years in HR Tech, payroll, or global employer\-of\-record.** Ideally split between hands\-on delivery and client\-facing / commercial roles. Companies like Deel, Papaya Global, Remote, Multiplier, Neeyamo, Employment Hero, JustLogin, Sprout Solutions, ADP APAC, TMF Group are the right shape of pedigree.
* **Sales\-call fluency.** You have sat in front of CHROs, CFOs, and Heads of People and closed. You know when to push and when to concede scope.
* **Strong communication** — written and verbal. Comfortable running executive\-level prospect calls.
* **Numeracy and structured thinking.** Comfortable with pricing math and SKU logic; can build your own analysis when the ask is ambiguous.

 **Nice to have**  

* Multi\-country payroll implementation exposure.
* Formal certifications — CPP / FPC (US), Certified Payroll Manager (India), or geo equivalents.
* Experience contributing to battlecards, competitive positioning, or sales playbooks.
* **Bonus depth** in Middle East payroll (UAE / KSA / BAH / QAT — SIF/WPS, GOSI, gratuity) or select European markets (UK PAYE, DE Lohnsteuer, FR URSSAF).

4aae99f2.description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced OSS Technical Delivery Lead to drive the aggregation, governance, and execution of OSS assurance demands across multiple markets. This role acts as the central demand “front door” for OSS assurance, ensuring alignment with digital portfolios, network operations, and local market needs while delivering against strategic 2025 transformation objectives.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Act as a single point of contact for Assurance SMEs for all demand and delivery requests across markets
* Manage OSS delivery projects aligned with transformation and integration of UK networks and local markets
* Own and track budgets (typically £250k–£1m), ensuring delivery within capex/opex forecasts
* Coordinate impact assessments, prioritisation, and demand mobilisation processes
* Maintain governance trackers including SCM approvals, mobilisation, and demand reviews
* Consolidate all OSS work packages into a rolling 18\-month delivery plan
* Manage demand intake, collaborating with digital, network, and OSS teams
* Lead OSS resource planning with internal teams and suppliers
* Publish KPI dashboards (e.g., Kanban boards) for demand and delivery transparency
* Identify and manage OSS risks in alignment with Technology Operations
* Oversee portfolio management for group business areas
* Track OSS budgets and supplier SOW approvals
* Manage external vendors and supplier coordination across OSS domains
* Drive cross\-market demand delivery and cross\-charging processes
* Utilise tools such as JIRA, PEGA, and Azure DevOps for workflow management


 Coordinate with geographically distributed teams, including European markets
   

  

**Who You Are**
* Extensive experience (10\+ years) in OSS and telecom domains
* Strong knowledge of software delivery lifecycle, particularly in Agile environments
* Proven expertise in demand and delivery management and governance
* Skilled in stakeholder and supplier management across global teams
* Proficient in tools such as Azure DevOps, PEGA, and JIRA
* Demonstrated ability to manage budgets and financial planning
* Experience working in multinational and geographically dispersed environments
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to navigate complex organisational structures and deliver outcomes collaboratively
* Professional certifications such as PMP or SAFe are desirable


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunity to lead large\-scale OSS transformation initiatives across global markets
* Exposure to strategic programmes within Vodafone’s network and digital ecosystem
* Collaboration with cross\-functional teams, including technology, operations, and suppliers
* Development of leadership capabilities in a complex, multinational environment
* Involvement in high\-value budget management and decision\-making processes
* Access to a collaborative and innovation\-driven work culture


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced OSS demand and delivery governance
* Strategic portfolio and stakeholder management at a global level
* Financial planning and budget optimisation in telecom environments
* Vendor and supplier negotiation and management
* Agile delivery practices using enterprise tools (JIRA, PEGA, Azure DevOps)
* Cross\-market collaboration and international programme coordination


**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
   

  

**Alert**
 Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
   

  

 \#JDEnhancedByTARA

**Company:** Corning
  
  

**Requisition Number:** 77588
  
  

The company built on breakthroughs.
  
Join us.
  
  

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.
  
  

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.
  
  

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.
  
  

Come break through with us.
  
  

Corning’s businesses are ever\-evolving to best serve our customers, industries, and consumers. Today, we accelerate and transform life sciences, mobile consumer electronics, optical communications, display, automotive, and solar markets. We are changing the world with:
  
  

Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
  
Damage\-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
  
Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
  
Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
  
Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
  
Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low\-cost solar energy solutions
  
  

Role Summary
  
  

We are seeking an accomplished Data Program Manager to lead a complex, cross functional enterprise data transformation initiative focused on improving data maturity across the company. This role will partner closely with divisional and functional Data Management Offices (DMOs), business leaders, and IT teams to drive execution of a broad portfolio of data initiatives spanning data strategy, data governance, data quality, data stewardship, data architecture, and data integration.
  
  

The Data Program Manager will be responsible for orchestrating a high visibility program that enables stronger data foundations, clearer ownership and accountability, improved quality and trust in critical data, and scalable data capabilities that support business transformation. This role requires exceptional program delivery expertise, the ability to lead global matrixed teams, and a strong track record of driving execution across business, technical, and vendor stakeholders.
  
  

While experience in enterprise data management is strongly preferred, success in this role will depend on the ability to establish structure, drive alignment, manage interdependencies, and deliver outcomes in a fast paced and evolving environment.
  
  

Essential Responsibilities
  
  

Support divisions/function in the execution of cross functional data transformation program within an Enterprise Data Management Office operating model across business and IT
  
Partner with enterprise, divisional, and functional DMOs to align priorities, define roadmaps, and advance enterprise data maturity goals
  
Drive coordination across initiatives related to data strategy, data governance, data quality, metadata, stewardship, architecture, master data, and integration
  
Build and maintain integrated program plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and resource plans across the portfolio
  
Establish and manage program governance, including leadership updates, decision forums, steering committee materials, and escalation paths
  
Ensure alignment between business priorities, data management capabilities, and enabling technology solutions
  
Apply Agile and hybrid program management practices, including planning increments, coordinating epics and features, facilitating ceremonies, and tracking delivery across teams
  
Define, track, and communicate program KPIs, outcomes, and status reporting for executive leadership and stakeholder groups
  
Coordinate global cross functional teams across lines of business, regions, and time zones to deliver against shared objectives
  
Partner with data, architecture, integration, analytics, and platform teams to ensure program execution is aligned with target state architecture and enterprise standards
  
Support implementation and adoption of data governance processes, stewardship models, quality controls, and operating cadences
  
Work with change management and business readiness teams to support stakeholder engagement, adoption, and sustainable process integration
  
Oversee third party vendors and implementation partners, including delivery coordination, issue resolution, and integration into program plans
  
Facilitate resolution of cross workstream issues and proactively manage impacts to timeline, scope, budget, and value realization
  
Help define the operating model, processes, and management routines needed to sustain long term data management capabilities across the enterprise
  
  

Qualifications/Requirements
  
  

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field
  
5\+ years of experience leading programs, portfolios, or large scale transformation initiatives
  
Demonstrated success delivering cross functional programs in matrixed and global environments
  
Strong experience in program planning, dependency management, risk management, financial oversight, and executive reporting
  
Expertise in Agile delivery frameworks such as SAFe, or hybrid Agile and Waterfall approaches
  
Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence across executive, business, and technical audiences
  
Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills in fast paced, high change environments
  
Proficiency with program and portfolio management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, or similar
  
Ability to lead international teams across multiple initiatives that span lines of business, geographic borders, time zones, and cultures
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

Experience leading data focused programs such as data governance, data quality, master data management, metadata management, data catalog, or data platform modernization initiatives
  
Familiarity with enterprise data management and governance platforms such as Alation, SAP MDG, Databricks, or similar technologies
  
Experience supporting digital transformation, ERP modernization, or enterprise operating model change initiatives
  
Understanding of key data management disciplines, including data stewardship, data ownership, metadata, reference data, master data, data architecture, and integration patterns
  
PMP, PgMP, or Agile certification such as SAFe, PMI ACP, or Scrum related credentials
  
Experience working with manufacturing, supply chain, finance, commercial, engineering, or other enterprise business data domains
  
  

General Desired Qualifications
  
  

The Data Program Manager will be an effective communicator and enterprise leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, align diverse stakeholders, and drive execution across a broad and evolving portfolio. The successful candidate for this position will have the following general experience and expertise:
  
  

Proven success in communicating with business leaders, technical teams, vendors, and senior management to align on goals, plans, risks, and outcomes
  
Ability to translate strategic objectives into executable roadmaps and measurable delivery plans
  
Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage changing priorities and complex interdependencies
  
Works collaboratively across multiple levels of the organization to develop practical and sustainable solutions
  
Communicates a compelling vision and sense of purpose for transformational work
  
Highly self motivated and directed
  
Team oriented with strong collaboration and leadership skills
  
Capable of influencing without direct authority across matrixed teams
  
Able to drive accountability and results in a complex enterprise environment
  
  

Travel
  
  

Limited travel as required.
