3f66ce44.title: Technical Program Manager
3f66ce44.description:
**Technical Program Manager — Healthcare Deployments** 




  





*Function: Implementation \& Delivery \| Reports to: Sr Director, Client Solutions* 
*\| Location: Bengaluru* 




  





**About Augnito** 




  





 Augnito is next\-generation Voice AI for healthcare. Our cloud\-based speech recognition gives clinicians ergonomic data entry with 99% accuracy, with no voice profile training, from any device, anywhere. Built from the outset in partnership with clinicians using human\-centred design, Augnito supports a wide range of clinical vocabularies and workflows, halves clinical reporting and admin time, removes transcription delays, and helps prevent physician burnout.
 



  





 Augnito is deployed at 300\+ hospitals and health systems across 20\+ countries, including the US, UK and Canada — delivered both directly and through EMR, HIS and distribution partners.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to own the deployment of Augnito into enterprise hospital environments — from contract signature through go\-live, adoption and stable handover.
 



 This is a customer\-facing delivery role in a clinical setting, not a back\-office project coordination role. You will be the single accountable owner of each implementation: running the plan, holding the dates, managing hospital IT and clinical stakeholders, coordinating our Product, Engineering, QA, Customer Success and Support teams, and working alongside EMR/HIS and channel partners who co\-deliver with us.
 



  





 You will have the authority to escalate, to raise change requests when scope moves, and to recommend holding a go\-live when readiness criteria are not met. We expect you to use it.
 



  





**What success looks like in the first 12 months** 




  




* Implementations land on the committed go\-live date, or the date is re\-baselined early and deliberately rather than slipping.
* Clinicians are actively using Augnito 30 and 90 days after go\-live — not just provisioned.
* Our implementation playbook, runbooks and readiness checklists are materially better than when you joined, and repeatable across geographies and partners.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Project ownership and governance** 



* Own end\-to\-end implementation projects from kick\-off through go\-live, hypercare and formal handover to Customer Success.
* Build and maintain project plans, milestone schedules, RAID logs, go\-live runbooks and readiness checklists; keep a single source of truth for every project.
* Run governance cadence with customers and internally: kick\-off, weekly working calls, steering updates, go/no\-go review, post\-implementation review.
* Manage scope actively. Where customer requests fall outside the agreed scope, raise a documented change request with effort and timeline impact rather than absorbing it silently.
* Identify, log and mitigate risks and dependencies early; escalate blockers with a recommended course of action, not just a status.
* Maintain implementation milestone status for commercial purposes, including milestones tied to invoicing and revenue recognition.



  





**Technical delivery and integration** 



* Gather clinical, business and technical requirements and translate them into an implementation plan, integration design, and test scope.
* Coordinate integration delivery with EMR, HIS, RIS and PACS systems — including HL7 v2 message flows (ADT / ORM / ORU), FHIR and REST API integrations, and embedded or in\-application deployment models.
* Coordinate endpoint and environment readiness: Windows and virtualised desktop deployment (Citrix / VDI / RDS), group policy and software distribution, mobile app rollout via MDM, SSO and directory integration (SAML / Entra ID / AD), user provisioning, network allowlisting, bandwidth and latency validation, and microphone or dictation hardware.
* Plan and manage migration from legacy dictation and transcription workflows, including existing templates, macros, auto\-texts, and custom vocabulary.
* Coordinate configuration, internal testing, customer UAT and production cutover; define entry and exit criteria for each gate.
* Validate speech accuracy and workflow fit by specialty during UAT; route accuracy gaps, vocabulary needs and product issues to the Clinical Language, Product and Engineering teams with reproducible detail.



  





**Clinical adoption and change management** 



* Plan phased rollout by department, specialty and site rather than treating go live as a single event.
* Identify and enable clinical champions and super\-users; design training for clinicians, secretarial and transcription staff, and hospital IT.
* Run go\-live support — on\-site or remote floor\-walking, early\-week check\-ins, targeted re\-training for low\-adoption cohorts.
* Own a defined hypercare period after go\-live with explicit exit criteria before handover to Customer Success and Support.



  





**Partner and channel delivery** 



* Deliver implementations jointly with EMR/HIS vendors, integration partners, system integrators and distributors — managing dependencies you do not directly control.
* Enable and quality\-assure partner\-led implementations: provide playbooks, training, readiness criteria and review gates so partners can deploy Augnito to our standard.
* Act as the delivery\-side point of contact for partner technical teams during integration build and certification.



  





**Compliance, security and privacy** 



* Run compliance and security readiness as a project workstream, not an afterthought — data protection agreements and BAAs, data residency and processing requirements, and customer security reviews.
* Coordinate responses to hospital security questionnaires and assurance frameworks with the Security and Legal teams, including HIPAA (US), UK NHS DSPT and DTAC, PIPEDA/PHIPA (Canada), the DPDP Act (India), GDPR, and ISO 27001 / SOC 2 evidence requests.
* Ensure clinical\-safety and information\-governance signoffs required by the customer are secured before go\-live.



  





**Scale and continuous improvement** 



* Improve the implementation playbook, templates, runbooks and estimation model based on what each project teaches us.
* Support pre\-sales where required: implementation scoping, effort and timeline estimation, input to statements of work, and RFP/RFI delivery sections.
* Contribute to reporting on portfolio health, delivery capacity and recurring root causes of delay.



  





**How Performance Will Be Measured** 




  




* On\-time go\-live rate against the baselined plan, and milestone adherence.
* Time\-to\-go\-live and time\-to\-first\-value from contract signature.
* Clinician adoption on day 30 and day 90 — active users and usage depth against the target user base.
* Implementation of CSAT / NPS from customer and partner stakeholders.
* Hypercare ticket volume and time to hypercare exit.
* Quality and reuse of implementation documentation and playbook assets.



  





**Required Experience and Skills** 




  




* 5–8 years of experience delivering enterprise software implementations, professional services or technical programme management, including at least 2 years in a customer\-facing delivery owner role.
* Demonstrated experience implementing software into healthcare provider environments, or equivalent regulated\-enterprise delivery experience with clear evidence you can operate in a clinical setting.
* Track record of running multiple concurrent enterprise implementations across different customers, time zones and readiness levels.
* Practical working knowledge of integration concepts: APIs, authentication, message flows, environments, and testing. You do not need to write the integration, but you must be able to challenge an estimate, read a message spec and spot a bad assumption.
* Ability to hold a professional line with senior external stakeholders — hospital CIOs, CMIOs, IT managers, clinical leads and partner delivery heads — under schedule pressure.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; the discipline to write status that is accurate and unwelcome rather than comfortable and vague.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills; high personal organization and attention to detail.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Candidates from hospital IT, clinical informatics, radiology, health information management or clinical backgrounds who have moved into vendor\-side delivery are explicitly welcome.



  





**Preferred** 




  




* Direct experience with EMR/HIS/RIS/PACS integrations and HL7 v2 or FHIR message flows.
* Experience deploying to virtualised desktop environments (Citrix, VDI, RDS) and managing endpoint software rollout at scale.
* Experience with speech recognition, clinical documentation, transcription, or medical coding workflows.
* Experience delivering through channel partners, distributors, or system integrators.
* Exposure to healthcare privacy and security regimes (HIPAA, NHS DSPT/DTAC, GDPR, DPDP Act) and to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 environments.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification.
* Tooling: Jira / Asana / ClickUp, Smartsheet or MS Project, Postman, basic SQL, advanced Excel or Sheets, Salesforce / HubSpot / Zoho.



  





**Working Model and Practicalities** 




  




* Portfolio: typically, 4–6 concurrent implementations of varying size and complexity.
* Geographies: customers across India, the Middle East, UK, and others. Expect regular working overlaps with Middle East and UK time zones.
* Travel: This role will require travel to customer sites (domestically and/or internationally) for go\-lives and key customer or partner milestones.
* Reports to the Sr Director, Client Solutions. As the implementation function grows, this role is the intended path to leading the team.



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




  





 Our technology works. The difference between a hospital that pilots Augnito and a hospital that runs on Augnito is almost entirely implementation — integration quality, clinician trust, and someone competent holding the whole thing together. That is this job.

**Global Program Manager — Query Fabric / Fabric as a Service (FaaS)** 




**Experience: 10\+yrs** 




**Notice period: Immediate \- 15 days only** 




**Location: Bangalore** 




**Work mode: Remote** 




  





**About the Role** 




 The Global Program Manager for Query Fabric / Fabric as a Service (FaaS) is responsible for leading the program delivery of unified query execution platform — enabling enterprises to run analytical workloads across heterogeneous compute environments and data sources through a single, governed fabric. This is a technically complex, ecosystem\-facing program that requires close coordination with engineering, cloud partners, enterprise architects, and field technical teams. The GPM owns the program structure that ensures FaaS capabilities are delivered with interoperability, enterprise readiness, and GTM alignment as first\-class outcomes.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own the Fabric as a Service program plan — defining delivery milestones across query engine integrations, connector development, governance layers, and cloud deployment targets.
* Drive alignment across engineering, platform architecture, cloud partnerships, and product management on FaaS scope, sequencing, and launch criteria.
* Manage the dependency surface between Query Fabric and other platform programs — including Elastic Compute, ADP, and Context Engine — ensuring workstreams are coordinated and blockers are resolved without downstream impact.
* Define and track enterprise readiness criteria for FaaS: security, compliance, performance SLAs, observability, and support coverage — ensuring each capability meets the bar before customer exposure.
* Partner with cloud and ecosystem alliance teams to manage external partner dependencies, integration timelines, and co\-launch coordination.
* Lead technical enablement readiness — ensuring that sales engineers, solution architects, and customer\-facing technical teams can position, configure, and support FaaS effectively at launch.
* Own program health reporting for FaaS leadership reviews, tracking delivery confidence, integration status, risk exposure, and partner readiness.
* Facilitate feedback loops between early adopter customers, field teams, and product engineering — translating real\-world configuration and performance signals into prioritized backlog input.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* FaaS capabilities launch with demonstrated interoperability across target compute environments, with clear documentation, validated performance benchmarks, and full technical enablement coverage.
* Cross\-program dependencies are managed proactively — engineering teams operate with clear interfaces and handoffs, and FaaS delivery does not create drag on adjacent platform programs.
* Cloud and ecosystem partners are engaged, aligned on timelines, and ready to co\-deliver or co\-market at launch.
* Field and customer\-facing technical teams are equipped to configure and support FaaS from day one, reducing time\-to\-value for early customers.



  





**Who You'll Work With** 




 This role requires deep engagement with platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, and solutions architecture on the build side, and with sales engineering, technical enablement, customer success, and cloud alliance teams on the deployment and adoption side. You will represent FaaS program status to senior leadership and navigate external partner relationships at a program level.
 



  





**Non\-Negotiable Qualifications** 



* 10\+ years of program management experience in the tech industry, with at least 5 years leading cross\-functional, global programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing technically complex platform or infrastructure programs — ideally with cloud, data, or query/compute infrastructure components.
* Ability to engage credibly with engineers and architects on technical scope and integration design, while simultaneously managing GTM and enablement workstreams.
* Strong dependency management skills — experience mapping and managing large, multi\-team delivery programs with external partner components.
* Effective communicator across engineering, field, and executive audiences.
* Bachelor's degree required.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with federated query engines, data virtualization, cloud data platforms, or multi\-cloud architecture programs.
* Familiarity with ecosystem partner management and co\-sell or co\-launch motions with cloud providers.
* PMP or equivalent certification; agile delivery experience in a large engineering organization.
* Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical discipline.

76b7598e.title: Product Solution Engineer
76b7598e.description:
**Product Solution Engineer** 




  





**Why is this important?** 




 Digital is growing exponentially. In just a few years, the billion people in India will be connected and consuming products and services digitally. This transformation is not only moving payments to digital form, it is opening doors to new kinds of businesses and consumer behavior that is transforming the finance industry.
 



 Internet \& mobile ecosystems are transforming commerce. While usage of credit instruments is growing steadily, the penetration of users purchasing with credit today is just 75 million. There are 400 million Indians with a private credit bureau score. Yet almost 300\+ million don't own a credit instrument or credit\-line to shop online.
 



 At Juspay, the Credit Platform team builds products that make purchases affordable and/or help customers seek credit to better finance outcomes, whether for consumers completing a transaction, or for suppliers and distributors working with a brand / manufacturer or an e\-commerce marketplace.
 



 We are hiring people who care about solving problems fundamentally as merchant success team members who will closely work with our customer’s product managers and developers and ensure their success. It is a mix of engineering understanding, product understanding and above all customer empathy.
 



  





**What does it take?** 



1. Drive the integration of Merchants and help to understand the problem and its cause by digging deep into data, logs, code and engaging with relevant stakeholders.
2. Imagine how the experience for customers \& merchants needs to be and constantly work on making it happen. Enhance ways of merchant self\-service and work towards faster onboarding.
3. Liaison with Product, Engineering, and Business teams to onboard the merchant and establish trust with the merchants by doing the right thing.
4. Be the doctor who doesn’t just hear symptoms from patients and give medicine for that but also pro\-actively helps to prevent any future diseases
5. Be technically hands\-on while resolving issues and develop a deep understanding of all our products



  





**What will I do?** 



1. Take ownership of merchant issues and requests through to resolution
2. Research, diagnose and troubleshoot issues by following SLAs
3. Guide non\-technical users through the issue resolution process
4. Product integration support for merchants
5. Collect and document information about users problems for future references
6. Follow standard procedures for proper escalation of unresolved issues to the appropriate internal teams
7. Provide prompt and accurate feedback to merchants
8. Document knowledge in the form of knowledge base tech notes and articles
9. Collaborate with team for application enhancements requirements



 10\. Data analysis, transaction reconciliations and investigation of disputed
 



 transactions
 



  





**Must have qualities** 




 1\. Aspiration for quality and bringing out what is expected
 



 2\. Genuine user empathy
 



 3\. Clear solutioning mindset by thinking from the customer's shoes
 



 4\. Strong problem solving skills
 



 5\. Extreme responsiveness to solve problems
 



 6\. Curiosity to understand how things work
 



 7\. Openness and patience to learn harder things
 



 8\. Attitude and ability to get\-things\-done and never let it go
 



 9\. Effectively balance big picture/details
 



 10\.Self\-motivated and driven
 



 11\.Persuasive without being forceful
 



 12\.Strong communication and interpersonal skills with people management skills
 



  





**Qualifications preferred** 




 ● Engineering with 2\-4 years of experience.
 



 ● Experience or eagerness to work in a highly charged start\-up environment
 



 ● A “keep going at it” and a “never say no” attitude towards problem solving
 



 ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills, ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to non\-technical users
 



 ● Ability to work as an individual as well as collaborate across teams
 



 ● Decent programming skills and basic knowledge of how tech works!
 



 ● Proficiency in SQL is a plus
 



 ● Any design/wireframing tool experience would be an advantage
 



  





**About the company** 




 Juspay's vision is to enable frictionless transactions for billions. The payments landscape in India, compared to the rest of the world, has been evolving at a much faster pace. It is unique in terms of being mobile\-first, mandating 2FA, next\-gen networks like UPI, merging online\-offline, being hardware\-less and so on. However, these advances bring along unreliable systems \& mandates to meet high\-security standards which increase friction for users.
 



 Juspay, with its zero\-one products \& next\-gen proprietary technology, is uniquely positioned to solve the end\-end payments problem in India and also expand internationally. We are extremely technology and product\-focused and have achieved exponential growth in an organic revenue\-driven way.
 



 Incidentally, our tech/design innovation was recognized and we helped the Government of India develop the BHIM app, which has set the gold standard for UPI interfaces \& even got international awards for its design.

**Candidates with exposure to North America implementations and an understanding of US statutory and compliance requirements will be preferred.**

  

This role sits at the intersection of:


* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large\-scale SaaS delivery
* You will act as:


* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go\-live milestones

  

**What the work looks like**


* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.


* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.


* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.


* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

  

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end\-to\-end.


That means:


* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities
* Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.

  

**Who thrives here**


* People who think in systems.


* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go\-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.


* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.

  

**What we explicitly don’t optimize for**


* Coordination\-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context

  

**What we’re looking for**


* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product\-oriented thinking
* Data\-driven and automation\-first approach to problem solving

  

**What We Offer:**


* A dynamic and collaborative work environment that fosters innovation.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* The chance to work on products that make a meaningful impact on businesses and their employees.

04db233d.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
04db233d.description:
**Job Description**
 Lead Technical Program Manager would be responsible for the transition, delivery governance, and execution oversight of WSP Digital Products. The role would coordinate product onboarding, roadmap execution, cross\-functional delivery planning, release readiness, operational readiness, and leadership reporting to ensure products move from MVP/transition state into stable, governed, and sustainable WSP\-owned operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Product Transition \& Portfolio Governance**
* Lead transition planning and execution for current and future digital products entering the portfolio
* Create and maintain product transition roadmaps, milestone plans, dependency trackers, risk registers, and readiness checklists.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer, documentation readiness, operational handover, and ownership transition from partner or vendor teams.
* Establish a repeatable product onboarding approach for upcoming products in the pipeline.


**Program Delivery \& Execution Management**
* Drive cross\-functional planning across product, architecture, development, QA, DevOps, data, release, and support teams.
* Track delivery progress, scope, milestones, dependencies, RAID items, decisions, and action owners.
* Support sprint, release, transition, and stabilization planning across multiple product workstreams.
* Ensure delivery execution is aligned to product priorities, business outcomes, technical readiness, and operational constraints.


**Stakeholder Management \& Leadership Reporting**
* Act as the primary coordination point between product owners, business stakeholders, engineering leads, architects, support teams, and leadership.
* Prepare concise leadership updates covering accomplishments, risks, blockers, decisions required, and upcoming milestones.
* Facilitate governance forums, steering reviews, transition checkpoints, and escalation discussions.
* Translate technical delivery status into clear business impact and decision\-support information.


**Operational Readiness \& Continuous Improvement**
* Ensure release readiness, support readiness, documentation readiness, monitoring readiness, and product handover closure.
* Support definition of product operating model, support model, escalation path, SLA/SLO expectations, and operational KPIs.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks, process gaps, transition risks, and improvement opportunities across product operations.
* Contribute to SOPs, governance playbooks, transition templates, and product operating standards.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Technical Program Management \| Advanced — transition planning, roadmap tracking, milestone management, RAID governance, and cross\-functional execution
* Product Delivery Governance \| Advanced — product onboarding, ownership transition, release readiness, operational readiness, and decision tracking
* Agile / Product Delivery \| Proficient — backlog awareness, sprint/release planning support, delivery tracking, and dependency management
* Stakeholder Communication \| Advanced — leadership reporting, steering reviews, escalation management, and business/technology translation
* Cloud / SaaS Awareness \| Proficient — enterprise digital products, integrations, DevOps, QA, support models, and SaaS operating considerations
* Risk \& Dependency Management \| Advanced — risk mitigation, assumption tracking, dependency resolution, and governance\-based delivery control.


**Required Experience**
* Minimum 10 years of professional experience in technical program management, delivery management, product operations, or enterprise software delivery.
* Experience leading product transition, product onboarding, vendor\-to\-internal\-team handover, or MVP\-to\-production stabilization programs.
* Proven ability to coordinate delivery across product, architecture, engineering, DevOps, QA, data, business, and support teams.
* Experience preparing senior leadership reports, steering committee updates, RAID logs, decision logs, and transition status packs.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, DevOps ways of working, release governance, and enterprise product operating models.


**Preferred (Not Required)**
* Experience working with enterprise SaaS, cloud\-hosted products, digital platforms, or integration\-heavy applications.
* Experience in engineering, environmental, consulting, infrastructure, or professional\-services technology domains.
* Exposure to CAB, ITIL change/release governance, service transition, SOP creation, and operational readiness processes.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Power BI, or similar delivery governance tools.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* PMP, SAFe, Scrum Master, Agile, or ITIL certification is preferred but not mandatory.

93d103c3.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
   

  

 At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
   

  

**We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.**
 Join AHEAD's Rapid Solutions Team as a Rapid Solutions Pod Lead, a role that spans engagement leadership, people leadership, client delivery, and offering development. You will be the primary point of accountability for every engagement in your pod, from the first client conversation through the executive readout, owning scope, governance, cadence, and outcomes. You will also lead a small pod of engineers, setting their goals and coaching their growth, so the team behind each engagement is as strong as the engagement itself. Beyond delivery, you will own the evolution of the Rapid Solutions offering, refining the playbooks, templates, and delivery standards that keep the practice repeatable and scalable.
   

  

 This role sits within AHEAD's AI \& Cloud Practice, so engagements center on helping clients modernize and optimize across multi\-cloud platforms, platform engineering, and AI\-driven solutions. You'll bring that focus to bear on every Rapid Assess and Rapid Solutions engagement your pod delivers.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
**5\+** 
 years of relevant experience in:
   

  

 Engagement Leadership
   

  

* Own every engagement end to end as Engagement Lead, from kickoff through executive readout, serving as the primary customer point of contact and the single point of accountability for delivery.
* Own scope and SoW compliance: set success criteria, manage change control, and keep stakeholders aligned on outcomes and boundaries.
* Run governance and cadence: standups, status reporting, stakeholder and steering reviews, RAID management, and decision logs.
* Act as the escalation point for engagement risk, resolving issues before they threaten scope, timeline, or the client relationship.
* Drive quality control through peer reviews and readiness checks on all client\-facing deliverables.


 People Leadership
   

  

* Lead a 2\-3 person pod, planning and executing work across discovery, analysis, and executive readout, and ensuring each engagement has the right people staffed against it.
* Set quarterly and annual goals for pod members and provide structured coaching and feedback to support their growth.
* Staff and manage utilization across sold and internal projects, forecasting needs and maintaining delivery rhythm.
* Maintain engagement hygiene: risks, decisions, and artifact version control.


 Solution Delivery
   

  

* Drive technical discovery and analysis across multi\-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), platform engineering, identity, networking, security, and app/data domains.
* Produce prioritized recommendations with effort sizing and a sequenced roadmap.
* Translate findings into executive\-ready narratives tied to business outcomes.


 Standards, Tooling \& Reuse
   

  

* Implement AI\-driven solutions to reduce toil and accelerate insight.
* Capture and evolve collateral (questionnaires, scoring rubrics, readout templates) and fold it into the Rapid Solutions playbook for consistent delivery.


 Practice Development \& Offering Evolution
   

  

* Define and refine Rapid Solutions offerings: own the playbook, templates, and delivery standards, removing ambiguity and ensuring repeatability.
* Partner with practice leaders to align Rapid Solutions standards with broader AHEAD delivery frameworks and cross\-practice initiatives.


**Why AHEAD**
 Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
   

  

 We fuel growth by stacking our office with top\-notch technologies in a multi\-million\-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.
   

  

**India Employment Benefits Include**
**Comprehensive health insurance** 
 coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents
   

  

**Paid time off and company holidays** 
 , along with additional leave benefits as per policy
   

  

**Flexible work arrangements** 
 , supporting work\-life balance
   

  

**Learning and development opportunities** 
 to support continuous growth and upskilling
   

  

**Employee wellness initiatives** 
 and programs focused on physical and mental well\-being
   

  

**Retirement and statutory benefits** 
 in line with India regulations
   

  

**Inclusive and people\-first culture** 
 , with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

e8d23328.description:
**Job Description** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced Delivery Manager / Project Manager who can lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex technology projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of technical understanding, project management expertise, and stakeholder management, with proven experience delivering projects for global clients.
 



  





 Experience: 7\+ years
 



 Job Title: Project Manager
 



 Location: Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur
 



 Job Type: Full\-Time
 



 Department: IT/ Engineering/ Software Development
 



 Work Model: Hybrid (4 days WFO \& 1 Day WFH in a week)
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Project Management
 



 ● Plan, schedule, and execute technical projects (medium to large scale).
 



 ● Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and milestones.
 



 ● Track progress using project management tools (Jira, MS Project, Trello, etc.).
 



 ● Manage project risks, issues, and dependencies; implement mitigation strategies.
 



  





 2\. Technical Oversight
 



 ● Understand software or system architecture and technical requirements.
 



 ● Review technical designs, deliverables, and quality standards.
 



 ● Provide input on technical feasibility and resource requirements.
 



  





 3\. Team \& Stakeholder Management
 



 ● Lead cross\-functional teams and coordinate with developers, QA, operations, and business teams.
 



 ● Conduct stand\-ups, status meetings, and sprint reviews (in Agile setups).
 



 ● Communicate project updates, roadblocks, and outcomes to stakeholders and clients.
 



  





 4\. Quality \& Process Management
 



 ● Ensure deliverables meet technical specifications and organizational standards.
 



 ● Identify process improvement opportunities to optimize project delivery.
 



 ● Conduct post\-project reviews and capture lessons learned.
 



  





 5\. Resource \& Budget Management
 



 ● Allocate and monitor resources effectively.
 



 ● Track project budgets, expenditures, and timelines.
 



 ● Ensure optimal utilization of team capacity and tools.
 



  





 6\. Documentation \& Reporting
 



 ● Maintain project plans, technical documentation, and progress reports.
 



 ● Ensure compliance with legal, contractual, and organizational requirements.
 



  





 7\. Typical Skills Required
 



 ● Project Management: Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, Kanban.
 



 ● Technical Knowledge: Software development, cloud, infrastructure, data integration, or a domain
 



 relevant to the project.
 



 ● Tools: Jira, Confluence, MS Project, Trello, Git, CI/CD pipelines (depending on tech).
 



 ● Soft Skills: Communication, stakeholder management, problem\-solving, risk management.
 



  





 Qualifications
 



 ● B.Tech \+ MBA / M.Tech / B.Tech (CSE), Any computer background \+ Management background.
 



  





 Salary and Perks
 



 ● In commensuration with the skills and experience of an individual.

a36a2af1.title: Senior Configuration and Delivery Manager
a36a2af1.description:
**Job Description**
 Configuration and Delivery Manager would be responsible for configuration control, release coordination, deployment governance, and delivery readiness across current and upcoming WSP Digital Products. The role would ensure that product configuration, environment readiness, version control, release packages, deployment approvals, and production releases are managed through controlled, traceable, auditable, and repeatable processes across development, test, staging, and production environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Configuration Management**
 Define and maintain configuration management standards across applications, environments, release packages, and deployment artefacts.
   

  

 Maintain traceability for product versions, configuration items, environment variables, dependencies, release baselines, and deployment records.
   

  

 Coordinate configuration changes across application, integration, data, infrastructure, and environment layers.
   

  

 Ensure configuration decisions are documented, controlled, and auditable.
   

  

**Release \& Deployment Management**
 Plan, coordinate, schedule, and govern product releases across current and upcoming digital products.
   

  

 Maintain release calendars, deployment schedules, release notes, release scope, deployment checklist, and rollback plans.
   

  

 Coordinate release readiness reviews, QA sign\-offs, DevOps readiness, CAB inputs, and production deployment approvals.
   

  

 Track release risks, deployment issues, defects, rollback outcomes, and post\-release validation status.
   

  

**Environment \& Delivery Readiness**
 Coordinate environment readiness across Dev, QA, UAT, staging, production, and support environments.
   

  

 Ensure environment consistency, access readiness, dependency readiness, and deployment sequencing before release execution.
   

  

 Support environment refresh, configuration updates, smoke\-test coordination, and deployment troubleshooting.
   

  

 Work with DevOps and engineering teams to improve repeatability and reliability of deployment practices.
   

  

**Compliance, Metrics \& Continuous Improvemen** 
 t
   

  

 Maintain release evidence, approval records, deployment logs, release decisions, and audit\-ready documentation.
   

  

 Track release metrics including deployment frequency, failed deployments, rollback frequency, defect leakage, and release predictability.
   

  

 Identify recurring release and configuration issues and drive preventive improvements with engineering, QA, DevOps, and support teams.
   

  

 Contribute to release SOPs, configuration playbooks, governance checklists, and operational documentation.
   

  

**Required Technical Skills**
**Configuration Management \|** 
 Advanced — software baselines, version control, configuration item traceability, environment configuration, and audit records
   

  

**Release Management \|** 
 Advanced — release planning, deployment coordination, CAB inputs, release readiness, rollback planning, and sign\-offs
   

  

**DevOps / CI\-CD Awareness \|** 
 Proficient — Azure DevOps, GitHub, branching, tagging, pipelines, deployment controls, and release artefacts
   

  

**Environment Governance \|** 
 Proficient — Dev, QA, UAT, staging, production readiness, environment refresh, and deployment sequencing
   

  

**ITIL / Change Governance \|** 
 Proficient — change, release, configuration, risk\-based approvals, governance documentation, and auditability
   

  

**Stakeholder Coordination \|** 
 Advanced — coordination across engineering, QA, DevOps, business, support, and leadership teams
   

  

**Required Experience**
 Minimum 8 years of professional experience in configuration management, release management, DevOps coordination, IT operations, or software delivery governance.
   

  

 Experience managing enterprise release cycles across multiple environments and product teams.
   

  

 Experience with configuration baselines, release packages, deployment records, change controls, and audit\-ready documentation.
   

  

 Working knowledge of Azure DevOps, Git, branching strategies, build/release pipelines, and deployment governance.
   

  

 Experience coordinating CAB approvals, release readiness, rollback planning, deployment validation, and post\-release verification.
   

  

**Preferred (Not Required)**
 Experience supporting SaaS, cloud\-hosted, or integration\-heavy enterprise digital products.
   

  

 Exposure to ITIL Change, Release, and Configuration Management practices.
   

  

 Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jira, ServiceNow, SharePoint, Confluence, or similar tools.
   

  

 Exposure to product transition, MVP stabilization, or multi\-vendor delivery models.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* ITIL Foundation, DevOps, Agile, or Release Management certification is preferred but not mandatory.

c9852673.title: Technical Program Manager
c9852673.description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
 



  





 Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




  





 A senior techno\-functional role sitting between business and engineering. You'll embed with business teams, translate their pain into buildable solutions, and drive them to production with Engineering Architects and Developers. Above all, this is a transformation role — you will change how teams and departments work and deliver measurable business impact across the firm. This is an AI\-first role: Claude Chat, Cowork, and Code are core to how you discover, document, prototype, and deliver.
 



  





**The Role at a Glance** 



* **Own outcomes** 
 across multiple business domains and drive firm\-level impact.
* **Set the agenda** 
 for requirements, prioritization, and build\-vs\-buy decisions.
* **Partner** 
 with Engineering Architects and Developers from design through production.
* **Set the AI standard** 
 and mentor juniors to lift the wider team.



  





**What You'll Do \& the Impact You'll Own** 




**Measured by outcomes, not activity. Within 12–18 months:** 



* **Drive transformation:** 
 Act as change agent across teams and departments; land measurable business impact and lift internal NPS / stakeholder satisfaction by 20\+ points.
* **Discover \& re\-engineer processes:** 
 Embed with business teams, map current/target\-state flows (BPMN), and cut cycle time 30–50% on 2–3 core workflows through re\-engineering, automation, and AI.
* **Translate to delivery artifacts:** 
 Convert workflows into user stories, story points, acceptance criteria, and BRDs precise enough for engineers to build without rework.
* **Partner on solutions:** 
 Shape design with Engineering Architects and Developers; stay engaged through build, test, and release.
* **Deliver AI\-first:** 
 Use Claude Chat, Cowork, and Code daily; drive 80%\+ active adoption and 25%\+ productivity gains across your domains.
* **Own roadmap \& build\-vs\-buy:** 
 Prioritize multi\-quarter plans; run POCs and present data\-driven build\-vs\-buy recommendations; unlock 1–2 firm\-level initiatives with measurable revenue or CX impact.
* **Deliver value \& reduce risk:** 
 Lead Agile execution and stakeholder buy\-in; deliver $500K–$2M\+ annual savings/avoidance and cut incidents, audit findings, and control gaps by 40%\+.
* **Lead \& mentor:** 
 Guide junior consultants (including as direct reports); raise delivery quality and win senior sponsorship.



  





**What You'll Need** 



* **Experience:** 
 10–15\+ years overall; 5–8\+ in Solutioning, product/project management, or technical consulting with a discovery\-to\-production track record.
* **Technical bar (screening filter):** 
 Write SQL, read APIs, interpret architecture diagrams, and critically direct AI coding tools like Claude Code. Non\-technical analysts are not a fit.
* **AI\-first delivery:** 
 Daily hands\-on with Claude Chat, Cowork, Code (or equivalents); able to set AI delivery standards for a team.
* **Transformation mindset:** 
 Proven track record of cross\-functional change that materially altered how teams work — measurable impact, not just delivered projects.
* **Technical foundation:** 
 Strong SQL, APIs, data modeling; solid grasp of SDLC, cloud (AWS/Azure), and modern architecture. Prior developer experience strongly preferred.
* **Delivery craft:** 
 Hands\-on process mapping, user stories, and acceptance criteria; extensive Agile/Scrum and Jira/Confluence experience across concurrent workstreams.
* **Leadership \& communication:** 
 Develop juniors, influence without authority, and write proposals that win senior buy\-in across business, technical, and executive audiences.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's required; Master's in Management, Technology, or related preferred. Prior consulting or vertical\-industry background a plus.

ad1c332a.description:
**Oracle APEX \& Oracle Fusion Cloud Solutions Architect**

 **About Us:**


**Atlas Systems Inc. is a Software Solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, Atlas provides comprehensive range of solutions in the area of GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare Provider and Oracle to customers across the globe. Combining our unparalleled experience of over a decade in the software industry and global reach, we have grown with extensive capabilities across industry verticals.**



For more information, please visit our website https://www.atlassystems.com/

 **Please click on the link below to apply for this position:**



https://atlas.bamboohr.com/careers/606

 **Job Title: Oracle APEX \& Oracle Fusion Cloud Solutions Architect**


**Location: Bangalore (Work from Office / Hybrid as applicable)**


**Work Timing: IST Hours**


**Experience: 10\+ Years**


**Engagement Type: Long\-term / Multi\-year (Contract / Full\-time)**

 **Position Summary**



We are seeking an experienced Oracle APEX \& Oracle Fusion Cloud Solutions Architect to lead the architecture, design, development, integration, and delivery of a custom Agent Billing platform as part of Project Fusion. The solution will support the calculation, review, approval, reconciliation, and invoicing of monthly agent charges that are not supported natively within Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.



The successful candidate will architect and build a scalable Oracle PaaS\-based application using Oracle APEX, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle Fusion REST APIs, and Oracle Database technologies. The platform will operate as a billing orchestration and calculation engine tightly integrated with Oracle Fusion Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting processes.



The role requires strong hands\-on Oracle architecture and development expertise, with the ability to translate complex business billing requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable solutions and provide technical leadership from requirements through production implementation.

 **Key Responsibilities**



Solution Architecture \& Business Analysis


* Work with business stakeholders, finance teams, product owners, and Oracle functional teams to understand agent billing processes, business rules, exceptions, approvals, reconciliation requirements, and invoicing scenarios.
* Translate business requirements into end\-to\-end solution architecture, application components, data models, integration flows, security controls, and implementation roadmaps.
* Design the Agent Billing platform as an extension to Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP capabilities without unnecessarily duplicating native Fusion functionality.
* Define functional and technical boundaries between Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle APEX, Oracle Database, OIC, and supporting PaaS services.
* Design scalable architecture capable of supporting monthly billing cycles, high transaction volumes, auditability, traceability, and future business expansion.


**Oracle APEX \& Application Development**


* Design and develop enterprise\-grade applications using Oracle APEX, including user interfaces, interactive reports, dashboards, forms, workflows, validations, and role\-based functionality.
* Build robust calculation and billing orchestration logic for monthly agent charges, including configurable business rules, adjustments, exceptions, approvals, and reconciliation.
* Design reusable APEX components and application patterns following Oracle development and enterprise architecture standards.
* Implement application\-level audit trails, status tracking, exception management, and operational reporting.
* Optimize APEX applications for performance, usability, maintainability, and secure enterprise deployment.


**Oracle Fusion Cloud Integration \& OIC**


* Architect and implement integrations between Oracle APEX and Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, and other appropriate Oracle integration mechanisms.
* Integrate with Oracle Fusion Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting processes.
* Design reliable integration patterns for data synchronization, transaction creation/update, status retrieval, error handling, retries, reconciliation, and monitoring.
* Develop and maintain OIC integrations, mappings, transformations, orchestration flows, and exception\-handling mechanisms.
* Ensure integration designs are loosely coupled, secure, scalable, observable, and aligned with Oracle Fusion Cloud integration standards.


**Billing, Reconciliation \& Financial Processing**


* Architect the end\-to\-end lifecycle for agent charge calculation, review, approval, reconciliation, and invoicing.
* Design calculation engines and configurable rules to accommodate complex monthly agent billing scenarios not natively supported by Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.
* Design reconciliation processes between the custom billing platform and Oracle Fusion financial transactions.
* Support integration with AR invoicing, AP processing, customer and supplier master data, project\-related transactions, and AP/AR Netting.
* Ensure financial data integrity, transaction traceability, controls, and auditability across the billing lifecycle.


**Database \& Data Architecture**


* Design Oracle Database schemas, data models, tables, views, stored procedures, packages, functions, sequences, indexes, and data access patterns supporting the platform.
* Develop efficient SQL and PL/SQL for billing calculations, data processing, validation, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Define data retention, audit, archival, performance, and data\-quality strategies.
* Optimize database performance and ensure appropriate transaction management and concurrency controls.


**Security, Performance \& Production Readiness**


* Design application and integration security including authentication, authorization, role\-based access, API security, secrets management, and least\-privilege principles.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and access controls for billing preparation, review, approval, reconciliation, and financial processing.
* Define performance, scalability, availability, logging, monitoring, and operational support requirements.
* Lead technical reviews, architecture governance, code reviews, deployment readiness, and production support transition.
* Identify technical risks, integration dependencies, performance bottlenecks, and architectural constraints and drive mitigation plans.


**Delivery \& Technical Leadership**


* Lead the solution through architecture, development, testing, deployment, and stabilization phases.
* Work closely with Oracle functional consultants, developers, QA, integration teams, business stakeholders, and customer IT teams.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to APEX, OIC, database, and integration developers.
* Create architecture documents, interface specifications, data models, technical design documents, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Promote reusable integration, APEX, database, and Oracle Fusion solution patterns and engineering best practices.


**Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**


* Stay current with Oracle APEX, Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle Database, REST APIs, and Oracle PaaS capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve automation, reduce manual reconciliation, and increase billing accuracy.
* Contribute to reusable Oracle accelerators, reference architectures, development standards, and technical best practices.

  


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of experience in Oracle application development, solution architecture, enterprise application integration, or technology consulting.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle APEX application development and enterprise solution architecture.
* Proven experience designing and implementing Oracle Fusion Cloud integrations, preferably across Financials modules.
* Strong experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, Oracle Database, SQL, and PL/SQL.
* Experience working with business stakeholders and translating complex financial/business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience leading technical teams and delivering enterprise applications in production environments.

  


**Technical Skills**



Oracle APEX \& Database


* Oracle APEX, Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, database design, stored procedures, packages, functions, views, triggers, indexing, performance tuning, and data modeling.


**Oracle Fusion Cloud**


* Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Financials, Accounts Receivable (AR), Accounts Payable (AP), Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting; understanding of Fusion business processes and REST APIs.


**Integration \& APIs**


* Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, JSON/XML, API orchestration, mappings, transformations, error handling, retries, monitoring, and integration security.


**Application Architecture**


* Oracle PaaS architecture, enterprise application architecture, workflow/orchestration, scalable application design, role\-based security, auditability, observability, and production operations.


**Delivery \& Engineering**


* Agile delivery, SDLC, requirements analysis, technical design, code reviews, testing strategy, CI/CD and deployment practices, technical documentation, and production support.

  


**Core Competencies**


* Oracle APEX Solution Architecture
* Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Integration
* Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
* Billing \& Financial Process Architecture
* Oracle Database \& PL/SQL Development
* REST API \& Enterprise Integration
* Business Requirements Analysis
* Application \& Data Architecture
* Security, Performance \& Scalability
* Technical Leadership \& Mentoring
* Stakeholder Management
* Technical Design \& Documentation
* Problem Solving \& Root\-Cause Analysis
* Production Delivery \& Operational Excellence


**Success Measures**


* Successful delivery of a scalable Agent Billing platform supporting calculation, review, approval, reconciliation, and invoicing processes.
* Reliable and secure integration between the custom billing platform and Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.
* Accurate and auditable billing calculations and reconciliation with Oracle Fusion AR, AP, Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting processes.
* High\-quality Oracle APEX applications and OIC integrations meeting functional, performance, security, and maintainability standards.
* Successful production implementation with minimal operational disruption and effective support transition.
* Strong stakeholder satisfaction and effective collaboration across business, functional, technical, and delivery teams.
* Contribution to reusable Oracle architecture patterns, accelerators, development standards, and organizational capability development.

fe650c0a.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.


We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!


Job Description


**Position Summary**

the Senior Cloud Engineer focuses on cloud data platforms and integration, reports directly to the FinOps Technical Leader. The Senior Cloud Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and supporting scalable cloud\-based data solutions across Azure and AWS. You will use your experience in Databricks, data transformation, API integration, automation, and cloud\-native technologies. It develops secure, reliable, and cost\-effective data platforms that support FinOps, reporting, AI plans, and business decision\-making. The Senior Cloud Engineer partners with IT, Finance, architecture, and business teams to deliver and enhance enterprise data and automation solutions.


**Responsibilities**

* Lead the develop, and support of scalable cloud data solutions using Databricks, Azure, and AWS services.
* Architect and improve ETL/ELT pipelines, lakehouse patterns, and data transformation processes using Spark, PySpark, SQL, and Python.
* Develop and oversee secure API ingestion and integration patterns for internal, vendor, cloud, and enterprise data sources.
* Promote automation, monitoring, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code practices to improve platform reliability, repeatability, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with architecture, security, FinOps, analytics, and your team to ensure solutions are secure, governed, cost\-effective, and enterprise\-ready.
* Mentor engineers, establish reusable engineering standards, and provide technical leadership for cloud data platform delivery.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems integration, or related technical roles.
* Advanced hands\-on experience with Databricks, Spark, PySpark, SQL, and Python for enterprise\-scale data transformation and pipeline development.
* Experience designing API ingestion patterns and integrating enterprise, vendor, application, and cloud platform data sources.
* Experience optimising cloud\-native solutions within Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Experience with CI/CD, automation, monitoring, and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* English proficiency required, in written and spoken English with technical and your team.
* Technical work in a matrix environment.

**Must have skills :**

* Experience with Azure services such as Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure Functions, Azure Vault, Azure Monitor, or related services.
* Experience with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, RDS, CloudWatch, or related services.
* Experience with Delta Lake, lakehouse architecture, data modelling, and enterprise data governance concepts.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, Git, Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or CloudFormation.
* Experience supporting analytics platforms such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, or similar reporting and data usage platforms.
* Understanding of cloud security practices, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management, and compliance requirements.
* Databricks, Microsoft Azure, AWS, or data engineering certifications required.
* Should resolve complex data, integration, or platform issues.

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

16411e57.title: Principal Revenue & Finance System Architect
16411e57.description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


**About the Team**

Join our team and experience Workday! It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they're doing. At Workday, we're committed to bringing customer focus and continuous innovation to the business of enterprise applications. We are looking for a Revenue solutions and Workday Finance Principal Architect that is hardworking, innovative, and passionate about designing innovative programs that drive engagement and support business success. We invite you to join our Workday\-on\-Workday (WoW) team!
**About the Role**

Envision architecting a world\-class Revenue Management ecosystem utilizing Zuora at a global scale. You will be working on the cutting edge of Order\-to\-Cash and Revenue Recognition technology, influencing how our financial operations scale and thrive. If you are passionate about Zuora and Revenue Management, Workday Financials and want to drive impact on a global stage, this is your dream role.  

  



As the Principal Architect for Revenue Management and Workday Financials, you will work closely with product managers, finance stakeholders, and business analysts to design and optimize innovative solutions across our billing and revenue ecosystems, ensuring seamless integration with our Workday Finance core. Get ready to dive deep into complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds, and see your solutions directly impact global financial operations. You will analyze complex functional business problems and provide technical expertise in identifying, evaluating, and developing systems and procedures that best meet requirements.  

  



### **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Architect \& Design:** Design and architect scalable, efficient solutions within Zuora and automated Revenue Management platforms to support global billing operations and compliance.
* **Implementation \& Configuration:** Lead the configuration, optimization, and scaling of **Zuora modules** (e.g., Zuora Revenue) and oversee critical upstream/downstream integrations.
* **Product Expertise:** Stay up\-to\-date on Zuora product updates, features, and evolving revenue recognition standards (ASC 606 / IFRS 15\), proactively identifying opportunities to leverage them.
* **Business Collaboration:** Partner closely with Finance, Revenue Operations, and business teams to gather complex requirements, translating them into robust technical specifications.
* **Guidance \& Support:** Provide functional leadership, technical guidance, and mentorship to other team members, system analysts, and end\-users.
* **System Optimization:** Troubleshoot and resolve complex system, billing, or revenue data issues, ensuring the smooth, automated operation of the Order\-to\-Revenue pipeline.
* **Cross\-Functional Integration:** Partner with platform services and integration teams to ensure seamless data flow between CRM platforms, Zuora, and financial ERPs.
* **Process Improvement:** Continuous research and analysis of industry best practices in Order\-to\-Cash and Revenue Management to recommend strategic improvements to our processes.
* **Roadmap Strategy:** Help envision and execute the overall Zuora and Revenue Management technology roadmap.

**About You**

**About You**
-------------

### **Basic Qualifications:**

* **10\+ years** of experience delivering large\-scale enterprise engagements with a primary focus on **Zuora Revenue** and automated revenue management solutions for global customers.
* Strong subject matter expertise in **Revenue Recognition standards** (ASC 606 / IFRS 15\) and subscription\-based financial models.
* Proven experience working within an **Agile methodology** framework and utilizing project management tools like Jira and Confluence.

### **Preferred Qualifications (Nice\-to\-Have):**

* Validated domain experience with **Workday Finance** (specifically Contract to Cash, Professional Services, or Financial Management modules).
* Active certification in **Zuora** solutions or functional areas of **Workday Finance** is highly preferred.
* Experience managing or architecting the integration touchpoints between Zuora and Workday Finance ecosystems.

### **Other Qualifications:**

* Outstanding analytical reasoning and problem\-solving capabilities, with a confirmed ability to think strategically to tackle complex, global business questions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical architecture and finance stakeholders.

  

  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**  



With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.  



  

Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision\-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.  



  

Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.  



  

If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com , as far in advance as possible.  



  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**

At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.  



Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.  



In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

20f9f506.description:
**About Impact Analytics**
 Impact Analytics is an agentic\-first AI software company transforming retail merchandising through cutting\-edge AI, LLMs, and Generative AI technologies. As a fast\-growing Series D company with deployments across five continents, it is building both industry\-leading merchandising solutions and foundational AI agents that are redefining how retail decisions are made.
   

  

 What makes Impact Analytics unique is its combination of deep retail domain expertise, strong innovation culture, and global presence. It is one of the few India\-born AI companies recognized globally by organizations like Fortune, Gartner, and the Inc. 5000\.

**The Impact That You Will Be Making**
 As a Senior Solutions Consulting Manager, you will serve as the primary customer\-facing expert leading solution design, process orchestration, and change management for Demand \& Replenishment Planning Solutions for Retail \& CPG clients. You are the functional powerhouse and architect for end\-to\-end, AI\-powered workflows. You will act as a critical liaison between project teams and key executive leadership, facilitating diagnostics and workshops to create robust solution design blueprints and ensuring seamless platform adoption.
   

  

**What This Role Entails**
**Solution Architecture \& Business Blueprinting**
* Lead Process Diagnostics: Facilitate and drive business diagnostics, process analysis, and design workshops to define as\-is/to\-be states for top\-tier retail and CPG clients.
* Author Functional Specifications: Draft comprehensive solution design documents, user stories, and technical requirements that align customer needs with IA's product capabilities with 100% traceability to financial outcomes.
* Design Multi\-Node Architectures: Architect scalable planning networks for complex retail scenarios like seasonal demand surges, multi\-tier distribution networks (DRP), vendor\-managed inventory (VMI), and supplier collaboration.


**Technical Governance \& AI/ML Forecasting Oversight**
* Advanced Engine Configuration: Configure and tune planning engines, overseeing logic for forecast disaggregation, outlier corrections, volume/value segmentation, and product phase\-in/phase\-out (NPI) workflows.
* Data Pipeline Validation: Model end\-to\-end supply chain integration layouts, ensuring robust data mapping, validation, and harmonization between legacy ERP/OMS systems and core predictive analytics layers.
* Agentic AI Orchestration: Leverage Agentic AI ecosystems to deploy autonomous agents for root\-cause analysis, scenario planning, automated workflow configuration, and demand\-supply exception management.


**Presales Execution \& Customer Success Delivery**
* Drive Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) Sessions: Lead solution demonstrations and tailored simulations, showcasing clear margin gains and dollar savings via live AI models to influence high\-stakes deals.
* Rigor in Testing \& Hypercare: Manage complex SIT/UAT testing loops, script validations, and defect triage cycles, taking full functional ownership of post\-go\-live hypercare stabilization phases.
* Change Management Evangelism: Coach enterprise customer planners and category heads through process re\-engineering, delivering customized user training bootcamps to maximize platform adoption.
* Team Mentorship: Lead, mentor, and build functional capability within junior consulting pods on product configuration best practices, AI/ML forecasting, and problem\-solving methodologies.


**What Lands You In This Role**
* Target Experience: 10–15 years of hands\-on solution design, configuration, or functional consulting experience implementing enterprise supply chain planning platforms.
* Elite Pedigree: Full\-time Master of Business Administration (MBA) from a Tier\-1 institution (e.g., IIMs, ISB, MDI, SIOM) strongly preferred, ideally paired with a technical or engineering undergraduate background (B.Tech/B.E.).
* Adjacent Platform Mastery: Deep functional familiarity with major target planning suites, including but not limited to Blue Yonder/JDA, o9 Solutions, Kinaxis RapidResponse, Anaplan, or E2open.
* Domain Domain Expertise: Proven technical mastery in Retail/CPG supply chains encompassing statistical baseline forecasting, causal modeling, multi\-echelon safety stock policies, ABC analysis, and network optimization.
* Technical \& Analytics Fluency: Comfort with relational databases and data modeling architectures, including hands\-on familiarity with SQL, advanced Excel, and visualization tools (Tableau/Power BI). Basic scripting knowledge in Python or R is highly valued.
* Certifications (Value\-Add): Professional credentials such as APICS CSCP/CPIM, PMP, CSPO, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, or platform\-native implementation badges.


**What We Offer**
* Innovation at Speed: The opportunity to deploy bleeding\-edge Agentic AI solutions that outperform traditional, static planning systems.
* High\-Impact Ownership: A flat, collegial, and high\-growth startup environment where you define your own career path and chart your growth.
* Competitive Compensation: Best\-in\-class remuneration packages, including generous health benefits, performance incentives, and equity options.


**Some Of Our Accolades Include**
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Companies by Financial Times for five consecutive years: 2020\-2024\.
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Private Companies by Inc. 5000 for seven consecutive years: 2018\-2024\.
