**Career Level – IC5**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Site Reliability Developer** to join the Engineering team within the SaaS Apps and Delivery organization. This IC5 role will provide technical leadership in designing, developing, operating, and continuously improving reliable, scalable, and secure cloud\-native services running on Kubernetes in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.


The successful candidate will own complex reliability and automation initiatives, influence technical direction across teams, and help establish engineering standards for deployment, observability, resilience, and operational excellence.


**Qualifications**

* MCA, BE, MS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of experience designing, developing, and operating large\-scale, customer\-facing web services or cloud platforms.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technical initiatives and influencing architecture or engineering practices across teams.
* Strong expertise in Kubernetes, container technologies, and managing production applications in Kubernetes environments.
* Strong understanding of Cloud PaaS, SaaS, and IaaS environments; Linux, Windows, or Solaris administration; infrastructure security; compliance; monitoring; and instrumentation.
* Proven experience with multi\-region architectures, high availability, disaster recovery, and capacity or performance engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience automating infrastructure and deployments using Terraform.
* Extensive experience designing and optimizing CI/CD pipelines, with GitLab, Git, Jenkins, and modern branching strategies.
* Proficiency in Python preferred, with experience in one or more of Bash, Golang, PowerShell, JavaScript, or Java.
* Strong understanding of automation, orchestration, Agile development, DevOps, and SRE practices.
* Ability to create and review technical architecture documentation and operational runbooks.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
* A collaborative mindset, with the ability to mentor others and drive adoption of new cloud technologies and engineering practices.

  
**Key Responsibilities**  

**Application Software Development:**

* Architects and delivers multi\-team features and modernization initiatives with clear, organization\-level KPIs.
* Establishes global production\-readiness standards (SLOs, error budgets, incident tooling) and drives adoption.
* Diagnoses and resolves high\-severity, multi\-system failures; creates systemic reliability improvements across apps/OCI.
* Harmonizes QA strategy across teams (test pyramids, non\-functional testing) to ensure consistent app quality.
* Makes significant architectural decisions; leads migrations and pattern adoptions with deprecation plans.
* Creates scalable blueprints and reference implementations adopted by multiple teams.
* Defines cross\-team API governance and dependency management frameworks.
* Shapes prioritization across multiple teams using data from field/customer, telemetry, and live\-site signals.
* Institutionalizes feedback loops into planning cadences; measures impact.
* Mentors Staff engineers; partners with Product and Design to balance customer value and technical strategy.

**Software Development and Coding \- Design, Testing, and Optimization:**

* Leads project initiatives to design software solutions and identify and analyze requirements. Writes and defines foundational code for new projects or prototypes.
* Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; coaches engineers across teams or units to drive improvements.
* Acts as a subject matter expert within the organization to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code.
* Leads process, architecture, and code reviews across projects and/or products/services to drive improvements.
* Utilizes modern/emerging technologies to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix highly complex software issues.
* Leads strategic initiatives to optimize software testing (e.g., functional and non\-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
* Encourages innovation, research, and relevant industry practices to optimize performance across products and domains.
* Resolves and may troubleshoot highly complex and systematic issues requiring innovation related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
* Implements innovative API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

**Software Architecture \- Software System Structural Design:**

* Leads task and project initiatives for the design and development of software, systems, and services. Defines project or design scope; reviews, influences, and approves scope and design recommendations.
* Provides technical guidance, domain expertise, and coaching in software architecture decisions and best practices that drive key organizational decisions, including industry standards and competitive considerations, providing mentorship and coaching for small teams and peers and contributing to both individual and team development across line of business/function.
* Utilizes innovative methods to conduct highly complex periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards.
* Collaborates with stakeholders across lines of business and externally, to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities.
* Implements innovative performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
* Conducts regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements and translates into decisions and plans that can have a major impact on the organization.

**Issue/Defect Collaboration \- Software Products Support:**

* Collaborates with stakeholders internally and externally to lead efforts to understand customer issues, root causes, and mitigation to align and explain rationale behind solutions.
* Must provide expert technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer\-reported issues to mitigate recurrence.
* Acts as an advisor to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements and solutions based on feedback.
* Networks across lines of business to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
* Guides implementation of strategic solutions for customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes.
* Investigates and troubleshoots the most complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short\- and long\-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

**Practices and Standards Compliance \- Security and Compliance:**

* Collaborates with the security team and leadership teams to establish, follow, and improve upon development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members.
* Participates in peer review processes and provides technical leadership with initiatives to ensure quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.
* Demonstrates, contributes to, and shares deep expertise of industry best practices and their application to software development processes.
* Implements highly complex secure software development practices/solutions requiring modern/emerging innovation to prevent security vulnerabilities, leveraging automated solutions to augment the manual review process.

**Development Operations \- System Maintenance:**

* Leads project initiatives for periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
* Acts as subject matter expert to drive improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

**Core Responsibilities**  

**Planning \& Execution:**

* Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high\-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements.
* Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

**Collaboration \& Partnership:**

* Influences cross\-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives.
* Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long\-term organizational success.
* Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

**Problem Solving:**

* Leads specialized, advanced problem\-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues.
* Guides others to leverage innovative data\-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drives the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization.
* Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions).
* Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices.
* Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization.
* Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals.
* Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

**Performance and Development:**

* Serves as a subject matter expert regarding talent needs and organizational talent strategy.
* Imparts leadership and expert knowledge throughout the talent development pipeline including candidate interviews, candidate assessment, and hiring decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational talent strategy.

e3b23a5b.title: Solution Architect
e3b23a5b.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Solution Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Translate client requirements into differentiated, deliverable solutions using in\-depth knowledge of a technology, function, or platform. Collaborate with the Sales Pursuit and Delivery Teams to develop a winnable and deliverable solution that underpins the client value proposition and business case.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Amazon Web Services (AWS)
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 AWS Architecture
   

  

**Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Solution Architect, a typical day involves interpreting and transforming client needs into unique and actionable solutions by leveraging comprehensive understanding of specific technologies and platforms. This role requires close collaboration with sales and delivery teams to craft solutions that not only meet client expectations but also support the overall business objectives and value proposition. The position demands continuous engagement with various stakeholders to ensure the proposed solutions are feasible, competitive, and aligned with client goals, fostering innovation and strategic alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to be a SME with deep knowledge and experience.
* Should have Influencing and Advisory skills.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
* Lead the design and development of scalable and efficient solutions that address complex client challenges.
* Facilitate communication between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment and clarity of project goals.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with AWS Architecture.
* Strong expertise in cloud infrastructure design and deployment using Amazon Web Services.
* Ability to develop architectural frameworks that support business strategies and technical requirements.
* Experience in integrating diverse systems and platforms within cloud environments.
* Skilled in evaluating emerging technologies and recommending appropriate solutions to enhance system performance and scalability.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 15 years of experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

 **Technical Solution Architect**

b21631b4.title: Cloud Applications Product Manager, CSS OU Curriculum
b21631b4.description:
Oracle University's SaaS Product Management team is responsible for the successful design, development, testing and rollout of all education **Products** for Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud Applications. The team is also responsible for creating Digital content and Subscription based offerings for customers.


We are seeking a passionate and experienced ***Curriculum Product Manager*** to lead the development, management, and delivery of learning content for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Cloud applications \- ***GHR, Talent, Workforce Management, and Payroll.*** .


As a SaaS Curriculum Product Manager, you will be responsible for shaping the curriculum strategy, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and ensuring content aligns with product roadmap, customer needs, and learning best practices. You will be engaged in partnering with cross functional subject matter experts to enhance content experience for our customers. This is a global role and will involve managing relationships with the Curriculum Development, IT Services, Product Development, Sales, Marketing and the Global Delivery organizations.


  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and manage the end\-to\-end learning content strategy for ***Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Products \- GHR, Talent, Workforce Management, and Payroll.***
* Collaborate with product managers, consultants, and subject matter experts to identify training needs based on product features and customer adoption trends.
* Design structured learning journeys and certification paths for various user personas (end users, implementers, administrators).
* Oversee the creation of high\-quality digital learning assets including videos, tutorials, hands\-on labs, guides, and assessments.
* Align curriculum with Oracle Modern Best Practices and ensure integration with Oracle Adoption and Success tools.
* Monitor learner engagement, feedback, and outcomes to refine content and improve effectiveness.
* Stay current with Fusion HCM product updates (quarterly releases) and ensure timely updates to associated training materials.
* Manage vendor or in\-house content development projects, ensuring timely delivery and quality standards.
* Support go\-to\-market teams with enablement content for new feature rollouts.
Champion learner\-centric design using data and feedback to evolve the curriculum.  
* 

**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in Oracle Fusion HCM systems.
* Proven experience in curriculum development, instructional design, or product training.
* Strong understanding of enterprise business processes and HCM implementation lifecycles.
* Excellent project management and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Ability to envision how to translate complex HCM features into intuitive and effective learning materials.
* Experience with learning tools such as content authoring tools, LMS platforms, video editing, SCORM, etc.
* Demonstrated ability to apply AI tools in day\-to\-day work — using generative AI to accelerate content research, design, and development, and a willingness to adopt AI\-first ways of working as they evolve.
* Strong communication skills and ability to present ideas clearly.

a19d93b3.title: Application Consultant-AWS Cloud Migration
a19d93b3.description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Consultant for Cloud Migration, you will act as a consultant for Cloud Migration Solution delivery, utilizing software architecture fundamentals and assets, tools, and the garage method for cloud. You will leverage your expertise in migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms to drive successful migrations.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Deliver Migration Solutions: Design and implement migration strategies for hybrid cloud platforms, utilizing rehost, refactor, rearchitect, replatform, and containerization techniques to ensure seamless transitions.
* Map Components to AWS Services: Identify and map existing components and functionalities to AWS\-specific services, considering the advantages and disadvantages of each service to inform migration decisions.
* Execute Migration Strategy: Carry out migration plans, ensuring successful architecture implementation and meeting client needs.
* Collaborate on Migration Tools: Work with stakeholders to identify and utilize effective migration tools, considering network requirements, application, database, and integration component migration pathways.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Cloud Migration Solution Delivery: Exposure to delivering cloud migration solutions, leveraging software architecture fundamentals, assets, and tools, such as the garage method for cloud.
* Hybrid Cloud Platform Expertise: Experience working with hybrid cloud platforms, including designing and implementing migration strategies, and executing architecture implementation.
* AWS Service Mapping: Exposure to mapping existing components and functionalities to AWS\-specific services, with a deep understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of related AWS Services.
* Migration Tool Proficiency: Experience working with migration tools, including understanding migration network requirements, application, database, and integration component migration pathways.
* Containerization and Migration Techniques: Exposure to rehost, refactor, rearchitect, replatform, and containerization techniques for seamless transitions.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Hybrid Cloud Platform Knowledge: Experience working with hybrid cloud platforms, including designing and implementing migration strategies, is beneficial. Understanding of architecture implementation and migration tool utilization is also valuable.
* Advanced AWS Service Understanding: Exposure to mapping existing components and functionalities to AWS\-specific services, with a deep understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of related AWS Services, is preferred.
* Containerization Technique Familiarity: Familiarity with rehost, refactor, rearchitect, replatform, and containerization techniques for seamless transitions is desirable.

57e07bf7.title: Technical Account Manager
57e07bf7.description:
**Tech Customer Spt Analyst III**
**Are you interested in supporting our customer’s needs and resolving their issues?**
**Would you like to be part of a collaborative and supportive team?**
**About The Business**
 LexisNexis Risk Solutions is a leading provider of innovative solutions for significant risk data analytics challenges. We are a forward thinking, progressive organization that provides tracing and data cleansing solutions, in addition, deliver critical and decisive processes for identity verification and compliance due diligence. LexisNexis is part of RELX Group plc, a world\-leading provider of information solutions for professional customers. Our products are continually evolving, and that’s where you can help. At LexisNexis Risk Solutions, we help our clients manage customer identity, identify and combat fraud, assess risk, and prevent money laundering and terrorist financing. Our aim is to facilitate safer financial transactions by helping clients to assess and manage relationship risk. Innovative technology and information solutions allow us to achieve these goals. That is why here, you will have the freedom to drive change, the trust to find your path, and the space to explore more.
   

  

 https://risk.lexisnexis.com/
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Customer Support Teams’ primary focus is to provide the highest quality service to support our clients. As the first point of contact for our customers, the team play a critical part in providing our customers with an excellent first impression of doing business with us. The team own the SLAs around incidents; meaning issues must be ticketed, investigated and, where necessary, escalated following those timeframes. We are uniquely positioned to play a core role in coordinating with multiple key stakeholders every single day, this provides a platform to drive change and enhance our current ways of working. Culture is extremely important to us, we value trust, empowerment, and support; the successful candidate will benefit from these within the role and encourage these values amongst their peers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Technical Account Manager, you will be a vital member of our team working with a diverse range of technologies and disciplines. You will enjoy working in a friendly environment and benefit from our investment in staff. Technical Account Manager (Finance Crime Consultant) with a background providing customer software support and a passion for data and technology, to join our Customer Support Team. This role serves as primary point of contact for an assigned client base product\-line responsible for overall account management, troubleshooting with the customer, ensuring optimization of LexisNexis solutions, and identifying opportunities for additional solutions or enhancements. TAM’s need to understand each client’s unique environment and provide the business and technical support where multiple LexisNexis products and services are implemented. In addition, TAM’s will partner with other LexisNexis teams to ensure a holistic approach to software, products, and services in support of the client’s business needs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Communicate directly with client technical and business teams to understand business requirements and provide technical recommendations and guidance. Proactively monitor client transactions and processes, perform analysis, and provide recommendations to necessary parties (i.e., technology, customer, and business leaders). Partner with all internal teams to create a single, seamless LexisNexis face to the client.
* Engage clients in assessing their business needs and making recommendations on optimizing software and processes including identification of training needs. Perform analysis and provide recommendations to ensure customer satisfaction with LexisNexis products and services while aligning with LexisNexis strategies and value propositions.
* Understand and document the technical requirements and implementation specifications for the client. Follow\-up on requests, resolve technical support issues and communicate solutions directly with client technical teams.
* Follow defined processes to provide timely status updates, root\-cause analysis and service level agreements metrics, and other reports to track customer specific data. Develop proactive tools to continuously improve customer support processes.
* Manage and lead critical support escalations, which often include multiple internal and external support teams and often with visibility to internal and external leadership teams. Will be the point of contact providing technical and product knowledge expertise and resolution to both technical and non\-technical audiences verbally and in writing through a variety of communication tools. Serve as a trusted advisor to the customer in implementation and process decisions.
* Assess customers’ risks and needs and recommends appropriate service offerings to proactively address. Document recommendations formally via service delivery plan and present to customer and virtual account team unit. Use project management methods to document, prioritize, track and drive implementations. Manage the delivery of recommended and agreed\-upon services to achieve high customer satisfaction and trust.
* Provide advanced level technical support for escalated customer issues conducting network configuration, workstation installation, server configuration, and hardware configuration analysis. This involves developing a support strategy, issue tracking, and follow\-up through root cause analysis. Travel to client’s job site to provide on\-site process analysis, consultation, training, and assistance to customers. Willingness to be on\-call when required to ensure client support is not impacted.
* Perform review of client business processes and understand relevant operations. Document and routinely review processes, procedures, customizations, and configuration. Create, manage, update existing Knowledge Base (Confluence, SharePoint, etc.). Mentor and coach LexisNexis team members. Cross\-train other teams/team members on processes and client\-specific implementations. Manage, prioritize, and advocate for customer requested enhancements with the product management team.


**Requirements**
* Great customer service skills and a passion for developing and maintaining relationships with experience in technical support customer contact position or consulting role.
* 2\-3 years continuous compliance / banking industry experience
* Ability to solve complex technical issues requiring in\-depth research and analysis with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Self\-motivated and diligent with excellent problem\-solving skills.
* IP/FTP/ SQL Server / IIS and MY SQL database.
* XML/ Working knowledge of MS Networking.
* Basic experience of CRM Systems (Salesforce, Jira, Confluence)
* Experience in API (SOAP, REST).
* Proficient Microsoft office 365 skills. (Outlook, Excel, PPT, Teams).


**Desirable Skills**
* Compliance industry experience desired.
* Understanding of software monitoring tools (Kibana).
* The candidate must have worked knowledge and been involved in medium\-to\-large\-scale systems implementation.
* Willingness and ability to travel to domestic and international customer sites.


**Our Commitment to Inclusion**
 We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including underrepresented groups, people living with disabilities, career changers, and candidates with non\-traditional education or experience. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are committed to supporting your success.
   

  

**Learn more about the LexisNexis Risk Solutions team and how we work**
**We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

ac2ed729.title: Claude Platform Managed Services Lead
ac2ed729.description:
**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
 The Managed Services Lead is the single point of accountability to the Customer for all Services delivered under the Three\-Track Model (Support, Managed Services, Consulting) for the Anthropic Claude Platform Managed Services engagement. The role owns Transition governance and planning through to Steady State, and leads communications, hypercare, and continuous improvement across the engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as the single point of accountability to the Customer for all Services delivered under the Support, Managed Services, and Consulting tracks.
* Lead Transition Period governance: establish the RACI and finalize the transition charter; run the weekly governance touchpoint with Customer stakeholders throughout the Transition Period.
* Own execution of the four\-phase Program Timeline — Mobilize \& Governance, Discovery \& Readiness, Transition, and Optimize \& Scale — and drive the transition from the Outgoing Providers (Accenture and Tribe AI) to BAU operations.
* Track and report progress against the transition milestones: BAU Readiness, BAU Assumable, Transition Exit, and the quarterly Industrialize marker (continued transition to agentic delivery labor).
* Coordinate the formal, time\-boxed knowledge\-transfer exercise with the Outgoing Providers, ensuring implementation artefacts (configurations, prompt/agent catalog, integration documentation) are captured and validated.
* Establish and maintain the executive dashboard for adoption, cost, and value reporting, and chair the reporting cadence with Customer's Executive Sponsor.
* Provide hypercare support through cutover to Steady State and own the transition to ongoing operations.
* Ensure ServiceNow/ITSM configuration (resolver groups, service level clocks, role\-based access controls) is completed and fit for purpose for the Services.
* Own overall Service Level performance across SL\-1 through SL\-8, monitor risk to targets (particularly through the 60\-day Stabilization Period), and drive remediation plans.
* Manage the change control process for any change to scope, rollout priority, or delivery expectations, escalating for amendment or Change Order as required.
* Serve as primary escalation point between the delivery team and Customer's AI Governance Lead, ITSM \& AI Owner, and Executive Sponsor.


**Required Qualifications**
* Claude Certified Architect – Foundations (CCA\-F) — Anthropic's official proctored certification for designing and shipping enterprise\-grade Claude applications (or committed to obtaining it within an agreed timeframe of joining).
* Proven experience leading large, multi\-track managed services engagements, ideally including platform transitions from an outgoing service provider.
* Strong command of ITSM/ServiceNow\-based service delivery models, incident/change/service\-request management, and service level frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience running structured transition/mobilization programs (RACI, transition charters, readiness assessments, cutover planning).
* Excellent executive\-level communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable chairing governance forums and steering committees.
* Working knowledge of AI/GenAI platform operations (e.g., enterprise LLM platforms) sufficient to govern a Claude\-based managed service.
* Experience managing knowledge\-transfer exercises from incumbent/outgoing providers.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Direct experience with the Anthropic Claude platform or comparable enterprise AI platforms.
* ITIL certification or equivalent service management credential.
* Experience in agentic/AI\-augmented delivery models.
* Prior experience serving as an engagement lead for a client in professional/real estate services or similarly regulated industries.


**You will be successful in this role if you have:**
 BA/BS degree and 12\+ years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience.
   

  

 Unisys is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that considers all qualified applicants without regard to age, blood type, caste, citizenship, color, disability, family medical history, family status, ethnicity, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, national origin, parental status, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, transgender status, veteran status or any other category protected by law.
   

  

*Local employment practices and rights may vary by jurisdiction and are subject to applicable local laws. This commitment includes our efforts to provide for all those who seek to express interest in employment the opportunity to participate without barriers.*
*If you are a US job seeker unable to review the job opportunities herein, or cannot otherwise complete your expression of interest, without additional assistance and would like to discuss a request for reasonable accommodation, please contact our Global Recruiting organization at* 
*GlobalRecruiting@unisys.com* 
*. US job seekers can find more information about Unisys’* 
*EEO commitment here*

2ea50525.title: IT Operations Readiness Solution Architect - Pune
2ea50525.description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an IT Operations Readiness Solution Architect to ensure new services, applications, infrastructure changes and technology transformations are ready for production deployment, acting as a key connection point between Project, Engineering, Development, Vendor and Operations teams.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead Operational Readiness Reviews and define Operational Acceptance Criteria
* Coordinate go\-live readiness, Go/No\-Go meetings, hypercare planning and exit criteria
* Define support models, RACI, escalation paths, SLAs, KPIs and governance reviews
* Ensure monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards and service health visibility are in place
* Validate incident, problem, change, recovery, runbook and knowledge management readiness
* Review capacity, performance, resilience, DR, BCP and scalability requirements.


**Who You Are**
* Experienced in IT Operations, Service Management, SRE or Application Support
* Skilled in Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Transition processes
* Confident managing production go\-lives and large\-scale transformations
* Knowledgeable in ITIL, operational governance, risk management and stakeholder communication
* Familiar with tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana or AppDynamics
* Experience in telecom OSS/BSS, Managed Services, Oracle, CRM, Middleware, Cloud or Digital platforms would be an advantage.


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunity to contribute to reliable production deployments and smooth service transitions
* Exposure to cross\-functional delivery across technology, operations, engineering and vendor teams
* Ability to influence operational governance, service reliability and launch readiness practices.


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced operational readiness and service transition governance
* Hypercare management, production go\-live planning and risk mitigation
* Practical experience with observability, resilience, support models and ITIL\-aligned operations.


**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

 Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
   

  

 \#JDEnhancedByTARA

3b642075.description:
**About Providence**
--------------------


Providence, one of the US’s largest not\-for\-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.


Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000\+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.


Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2\.0\. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In\-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation
**Role Overview**


The Principal Program Manager will lead strategic, cross\-functional programs that drive innovation and operational excellence across Cyber Engineering initiatives, while ensuring alignment with enterprise infrastructure and cybersecurity standards. This role requires deep program management expertise, strong technical acumen, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across engineering and business teams.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Program Leadership:**


* Plan, organize, and manage multiple programs ensuring alignment with organizational strategy and objectives.
* Develop and maintain program roadmaps aligned with organizational priorities.
* Anticipate risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure timely delivery.
* Drive execution across diverse teams, resolving issues and managing dependencies.
* Define KPIs and success metrics for programs.Ensure continuous improvement through feedback loops and process optimization.
* Effectively lead all scrum ceremonies.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:**


* Partner with Data Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure seamless integration of solutions.
* Foster collaboration across stakeholders, vendors, and leadership teams.

**Change \& Conflict Management:**


* Apply organizational change management methodologies to ensure successful adoption of new processes and technologies.
* Proactively manage and resolve conflicts within teams and across stakeholders to maintain program momentum.

**Communication \& Stakeholder Engagement:**


Develop and execute communication strategies tailored to diverse audiences.Influence and align senior leaders, engineering managers, and business stakeholders.Provide program status, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders and executive leadership in a clear and concise manner.


**Required Skills and Experience**


* 10\+ years experience in IT, with min. 5\+ years in program/project management within engineering teams.
* Proven track record of managing programs involving Data Engineering. Exposure to Enterprise Security/Infrastructure domains.Experience working in a global setup and managing stakeholders and engineering teams across India and US teams.
* Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization.Proficient in Agile methodologies with strong expertise in Scrum practices.Exceptional verbal and written communication for stakeholder engagement and executive reporting.Understanding of Cloud platforms and Data Engineering practices.
* Expertise in program governance, risk management, and change management.
Providence’s vision to create ‘Health for a Better World’ aids us to provide a fair and equitable workplace for all in our employment, whether temporary, part\-time or full time, and to promote individuality and diversity of thought and background, and acknowledge its role in the organization’s success. This makes us committed towards equal employment opportunities, regardless of race, religion or belief, color, ancestry, disability, marital status, gender, sexual orientation, age, nationality, ethnic origin, pregnancy, or related needs, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, or any other category protected by applicable law. In furtherance to our mission in building a more inclusive and equitable environment, we shall, from time to time, undertake programs to assist, uplift and empower underrepresented groups including but not limited to Women, PWD (Persons with Disabilities), LGTBQ\+ (Lesbian, Gay, Transgender, Bisexual or Queer), Veterans and others. We strive to address all forms of discrimination or harassment and provide a safe and confidential process to report any misconduct.


Contact our Integrity hotline also, read our Code of Conduct.

bb557641.title: Service Delivery Program Manager
bb557641.description:
**Who We Are**
 Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award\-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting\-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people\-first culture.
   

  

 With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end\-to\-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile \& Digital Marketing \| Enterprise AI \| Customer Care AI \& Technology \| Enterprise Technology Modernization
   

  

**Location \& Flexibility**
 Noida, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Program Manager / Senior Manager to lead end\-to\-end cloud migration and modernization initiatives across multi\-cloud environments — including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Microsoft Azure. In this highly visible role, you will drive large\-scale transformation programs that accelerate the organization's cloud adoption, modernize legacy workloads, and deliver measurable business outcomes. You will partner closely with executive stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, and vendors to define program strategy, govern delivery, manage risk, and champion cloud\-native best practices across the enterprise. This role requires a blend of technical acumen, program governance expertise, and leadership presence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership \& Governance**
* Develop and own the end\-to\-end program roadmap for cloud migration and modernization, spanning GCP, AWS, and Azure environments.
* Establish and manage program governance frameworks including steering committees, status reporting, RACI structures, and decision\-making processes.
* Lead cross\-functional teams of architects, engineers, DevOps practitioners, and business analysts across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Track and report on program health — scope, schedule, budget, risk, and quality — to senior leadership and C\-suite stakeholders.
* Drive milestone delivery, manage dependencies, and resolve escalations to keep programs on track.


**Cloud Migration Execution**
* Define and execute migration strategies including Rehost (lift \& shift), Replatform, Refactor,Repurchase, Retire, and Retain (6Rs/7Rs).
* Oversee infrastructure assessments, application portfolio rationalization, and cloud readiness evaluations.
* Coordinate migration waves, manage cutover planning, and ensure zero\-downtime or minimal\-disruption transitions for critical workloads.
* Manage relationships with hyperscale partners (Google, AWS, Microsoft) and third\-party migration tooling vendors.
* Ensure proper implementation of cloud landing zones, networking, IAM, security controls, and compliance requirements.


**Modernization \& Transformation**
* Champion cloud\-native modernization initiatives including containerization(Kubernetes/GKE/EKS/AKS), microservices adoption, and serverless architectures.
* Drive application re\-platforming to managed cloud services (e.g., Cloud SQL, RDS, Azure SQL, Big Query, Redshift, Synapse).
* Lead DevSecOps and CI/CD pipeline modernization to enable continuous delivery and cloud\-native development practices.
* Partner with data and AI/ML teams to enable cloud\-native analytics and AI workloads on GCP(Vertex AI), AWS (SageMaker), and Azure (Azure AI).


**Financial \& Risk Management**
* Own program budgets ranging from $5M to $50M\+, with responsibility for FinOps, cost optimization, and cloud spend visibility.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate technical, operational, and business risks throughout the program lifecycle.
* Drive business case development, ROI modeling, and benefits tracking for cloud transformation investments.


**Stakeholder Management \& Change Management**
* Act as the primary program interface for senior technology and business leaders, building trust and ensuring alignment across stakeholders.
* Develop and execute organizational change management plans to drive cloud adoption and new ways of working.
* Build cloud capability and literacy across engineering and product teams through training, communities of practice, and enablement programs.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of program/project management experience with 5\+ years directly in cloud migration or transformation programs
* Demonstrated delivery of large\-scale migrations ($10M\+ budgets) on at least two of: GCP, AWS, Azure
* Experience managing multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud environments with 500\+ workloads or applications
* Track record of managing cross\-functional teams of 20\+ people across engineering, architecture, and business functions
* Experience with enterprise change management and organizational transformation

Boston Scientific is seeking an **AI Platform Architect** to design, evolve, and operate a shared enterprise AI platform used by multiple projects and product teams across the organization. This is a **senior technical individual contributor role** focused on enterprise AI platform capabilities, governance, security, observability, evaluation, MLOps/LLMOps, CI/CD, multi\-cloud and multi\-region integration, operational support, and reusable enterprise tooling. The role will define platform standards and also contribute hands\-on where needed to integrate services, automate lifecycle processes, support production environments, and resolve complex platform issues.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

 **AI Platform Architecture \& Capabilities**

* Design and evolve a **shared enterprise AI platform** that supports multiple projects, business units, and product teams.
* Define reusable platform capabilities for GenAI, RAG, model access, orchestration, prompt management, evaluation, observability, governance, and security.
* Build and maintain **AI/model gateways, service catalogs, reusable APIs, SDKs, platform integrations, and enterprise self\-service tools**.
* Establish platform standards and reference patterns that enable teams to consume approved AI capabilities consistently and securely.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and mature proven approaches into scalable enterprise platform capabilities.

**MLOps, LLMOps \& CI/CD**

* Build and maintain **CI/CD pipelines** for AI services, models, prompts, agents, configurations, and platform components.
* Implement **MLOps/LLMOps** practices for model lifecycle management, versioning, evaluation, deployment, rollback, monitoring, and release governance.
* Develop automated evaluation frameworks for quality, grounding, safety, latency, reliability, and model performance.
* Implement enterprise observability across model calls, prompts, integrations, token usage, cost, logs, traces, and platform health.
* Standardize production\-readiness, deployment, and promotion patterns across projects, environments, regions, and cloud platforms.

**Multi\-Cloud Integration, Enterprise Tools \& Support**

* Design and operate AI platform capabilities across **Azure, AWS, and Snowflake**, with support for multi\-cloud and multi\-region deployment patterns.
* Build reusable enterprise integrations connecting AI services with internal applications, data platforms, APIs, identity services, and approved third\-party platforms.
* Develop and support shared enterprise tools, APIs, automation, and platform services that can be reused across multiple projects.
* Provide hands\-on **production support**, including incident triage, root\-cause analysis, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and operational improvements.
* Design for scalability, reliability, resilience, regional availability, security, cost efficiency, and maintainability across platform services and integrations.

**Security, Governance \& Platform Standards**

* Embed **security\-by\-design, privacy\-by\-design, Responsible AI, and compliance\-by\-design** into platform capabilities.
* Implement IAM, audit logging, access controls, traceability, data protection, AI security guardrails, and policy enforcement.
* Define reusable reference architectures, APIs, SDKs, design patterns, ADRs, governance controls, and platform standards.
* Partner with Cybersecurity, Privacy, Quality, Enterprise Architecture, and engineering teams to translate governance requirements into practical technical controls.

**Technical Leadership**

* Act as a **senior technical contributor**, helping project teams adopt and integrate shared AI platform capabilities.
* Provide technical guidance through design reviews, code reviews, reference implementations, and mentoring.
* Translate project and business requirements into reusable, scalable platform capabilities while remaining engaged in implementation and support.

 **Required Qualificaitons:**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* Strong experience designing and operating **enterprise platforms** used by multiple projects or product teams.

* Proven experience with **GenAI / LLM platform capabilities**, including RAG, model integration, evaluation, observability, and lifecycle management.
* Working knowledge of **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**, including MCP\-based integration patterns, tool connectivity, security, and governance.
* Strong experience with **MLOps/LLMOps, CI/CD, governance, security, production support, release management, and AI lifecycle automation**.
* Experience with **Azure, AWS, and Snowflake** AI/data platforms, cloud\-native architecture, enterprise integration, and production operations.
* Experience with **LangChain / LangGraph** for AI orchestration and platform integration patterns.
* Experience designing for **multi\-cloud and multi\-region** deployment, resilience, and operational support.
* Ability to move independently from **technical design through implementation, deployment, troubleshooting, and operationalization**.
* Strong understanding of secure, scalable software architecture and engineering fundamentals.
* Willingness to work with **some overlap with US business hours** to collaborate with US\-based teams and stakeholders.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience with **MCP, Agent Mesh, tool gateways, agent registries, model gateways, and enterprise AI service catalogs**.
* Experience with vector databases, Snowflake Cortex, and Kubernetes/EKS/ECS.
* Experience developing reusable SDKs, platform APIs, shared services, or internal developer platforms.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation, observability, Responsible AI, AI cost optimization, and platform FinOps.
* Experience in healthcare, life sciences, medical technology, or another regulated industry.

As a global medical technology leader for more than 45 years, we advance science for life by providing a broad range of high\-performance solutions that address unmet patient needs and reduce the cost of healthcare. Our portfolio of devices and therapies helps physicians diagnose and treat complex cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, oncological, neurological and urological diseases and conditions.  What makes Impact Analytics unique is its combination of deep retail domain expertise, strong innovation culture, and global presence. It is one of the few India\-born AI companies recognized globally by organizations like Fortune, Gartner, and the Inc. 5000\.

**Our Accolades Include**

bcbde9d7.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
bcbde9d7.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Technical Program Manager
Overview  

  

* The Decision Management program enables intelligent decision\-based products through streaming analytics with the ability to govern decisions and manage outcomes with business agility.
* This program leverages business rules and AI engines, streaming big data platforms, in\-memory data grids, APIs, cloud\-native services, and modern user interfaces to deliver real\-time decisions at global scale.
* This role is responsible for driving large\-scale cross\-functional programs, aligning engineering, product, data science, and business stakeholders, and ensuring successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
* The Technical Program Manager will provide leadership across multiple teams, help define execution strategy, identify and mitigate risks, and drive operational excellence across the program lifecycle.

  

We are looking for a \*\*Technical Program Manager\*\* to join our Decision Management Platform (DMP) team.  

  

* Are you passionate about driving complex technical programs from conception to delivery?
* Do you enjoy collaborating with engineering, product, architecture, operations, and business stakeholders to achieve strategic outcomes?
* Are you excited about working on large\-scale, mission\-critical systems that process millions of transactions in real time?
* Do you want to play a key role in helping prevent fraud and enable intelligent decisioning across Mastercard products worldwide?

  

Role  

  

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of strategic technical programs across multiple engineering teams.
* Define program scope, objectives, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering Managers, Architects, Data Scientists, and Business stakeholders to deliver business outcomes.
* Drive planning, execution, risk management, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication.
* Establish and maintain program governance, reporting, and executive\-level status updates.
* Facilitate technical discussions and support architectural decision\-making across teams.
* Identify program risks early and drive mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery.
* Coordinate platform modernization, cloud migration, AI/ML enablement, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Lead Agile planning activities, including roadmap reviews, PI planning, sprint tracking, and release coordination.
* Monitor program health, delivery metrics, capacity planning, and resource utilization.
* Ensure alignment with security, compliance, reliability, and quality standards.
* Foster collaboration and drive continuous improvement across engineering and product organizations.
* Support incident management, postmortem reviews, and execution of corrective actions when required.

  

Essential Knowledge / Experience  

  

* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile delivery methodologies.
* Experience managing large\-scale distributed systems, cloud\-native platforms, enterprise applications, and modern engineering architectures.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional programs involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Strong experience in program planning, roadmap management, dependency management, and risk mitigation.
* Experience working with Agile frameworks such as Scrum, SAFe, or Kanban.
* Strong understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and platform operations.
* Experience with cloud technologies
* Experience tracking and reporting program metrics, KPIs, and operational health indicators.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive\-level presentations.
* Experience managing technical dependencies across engineering, product, infrastructure, and operations teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across diverse teams.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Experience using project and program management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.

  

Desirable Skills  

  

* Experience delivering AI/ML, data platform, or advanced analytics programs.
* Knowledge of business rules technologies such as IBM ODM/ILOG.
* Experience with distributed data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and in\-memory data grids (GemFire, Redis, etc.).
* Knowledge of observability and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana, or Prometheus.
* Experience managing cloud migration, platform modernization, or large\-scale transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of cybersecurity, secure software development practices, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* PMP, PgMP, PMI\-ACP, SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), SAFe Agilist, or equivalent certification preferred.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.

  

Key Success Measures  

  

* Successful delivery of strategic programs on time and within scope.
* Effective management of cross\-team dependencies and risks.
* Improved engineering productivity, predictability, and operational excellence.
* High stakeholder satisfaction and alignment across business and technology organizations.
* Measurable impact on platform scalability, reliability, modernization, and business outcomes.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

d675af25.title: Engagement Manager (HCM Implementation, People Manager)
d675af25.description:
**About Darwinbox**
 Darwinboxis Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries. Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision\-making.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of:
   

  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large\-scale SaaS delivery


 You will act as:
   

  

* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go\-live milestones


**What The Work Looks Like**
* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.


 Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end\-to\-end.
   

  

 That means:
   

  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities


 Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.
   

  

**Who Thrives Here**
* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go\-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.


**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**
* Coordination\-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context


**What We’re Looking For**
* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product\-oriented thinking
* Data\-driven and automation\-first approach to problem solving


 Lastly, what we are not looking for
 **,** 
 we’re not looking for traditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely not people who measure success by whether the tracker is green.

**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**

**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**

CMC Program Manager, Technical Development


Role Description


The CMC Program Manager will oversee CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) timelines and workstreams across projects within the Technical Development (TD) Functional Excellence framework. This role is pivotal for extracting information critical for resourcing, strategic decisions, and the annual Business Plan. The incumbent ensures that CMC timelines are consistent and integrated, and that resource/vendor allocation is clearly understood to meet budgetary targets.


Acting as the operational data "engine" that informs broader TD Functional Excellence scorecards and platforms, this role interfaces between TPLs, the Project Management (PM) group, and TD Functional Leaders. The incumbent leverages project management expertise and TD knowledge to drive accountability, increase transparency, and improve spending accuracy across the portfolio.


\-


Key Responsibilities


CMC Timeline \& Milestone Integrity


· Integrated Timeline Management: Harmonize comprehensive CMC project timelines to extract critical data on siting, resource requirements, and potential constraints, enabling data\-driven strategic decisions.


· Critical Path \& Clash Analysis: Identify dependencies and resourcing "clashes" in CMC development paths to facilitate proactive risk mitigation and siting prioritization.


· TD Functional Excellence Support: Collaborate across the TD Leadership (TPLs, Functional Leaders) to integrate CMC operational frameworks (e.g., milestone definitions, suitable KPIs, leading/lagging indicators) into broader TD standards and support initiatives as needed.


Resource Tracking


· Specific Resource Tracking: Define robust mechanisms to track resource utilization (FTEs/Capacity) at the project and functional levels to flag constraints or availability.


· Business Plan Support: Directly support the yearly Business Plan process by providing accurate resource forecasts and conducting "what\-if" scenario modeling based on portfolio priorities or potential project accelerations.


Financial Stewardship \& Budgetary Oversight


· Budget Alignment \& Forecasting: Partner closely with TPLs and the PM group to improve the management of project\-specific CMC budgets, ensuring accuracy in forecasting and strict adherence to financial targets.


· Audit \& Variance Management: Proactively audit project\-specific CMC spending against the Business Plan to flag variances, and improve future forecasting accuracy.


\-


Basic Qualifications


· Bachelor or Master level degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Pharmacy, or similar).


· Several years of Project Management experience specifically within an R\&D environment, with a strong focus on CMC workstreams.


· Demonstrated understanding of the Technical Development (TD) space, including regulatory requirements and manufacturing interfaces.


· Proven exposure to resource planning and budget management for complex programs.


· Ability to work effectively and influence global, cross\-functional teams with or without direct authority.


Additional Skills / Preferences


· Strong experience with portfolio\-level metadata and resource tracking tools.


· Deep understanding of the Innovation Cycle, MR process, and Business Plan process.


· Lean/6sigma experience and a mindset for process optimization.


· Knowledge of R\&D IT tools and an agile learner of new systems for data visualization.

739772a7.title: Technical Program Manager II
739772a7.description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud\-enabled world.
   

  

 Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging \& real\-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data\-first applications and driving a data culture.
   

  

 Within Azure Data, the Microsoft Fabric platform team builds and maintains the operating system and provides customers a unified data stack to run an entire data estate. The platform provides a unified experience, unified governance, enables a unified business model and a unified architecture.
   

  

 We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to strengthen how Fabric Quality measures, reports, and acts on service health — a top organizational focus and a critical effort for the business. This role builds trusted reporting, automates the manual workflows behind the quality rhythm, and standardizes service\-health telemetry and metrics, so "healthy" means the same thing across teams and raw signal becomes insight leaders and engineering teams act on. The team moves quickly, and the role calls for comfort working in an agile, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 The work is hands\-on and cross\-team: identifying gaps across scenarios, defining the success criteria and metrics that matter, and ensuring the telemetry behind them is complete and trustworthy. It suits a TPM who executes reliably across multiple workstreams, cares about data correctness and consistency, and is proficient with telemetry, reporting, and automation — Power BI / DAX, Kusto, and scripting to remove manual toil. Working through ambiguity, developing hypotheses and solutions, and coordinating across engineering and data teams to land defined problems end\-to\-end — with a bias toward repeatable, AI\- and automation\-assisted workflows — rounds out the profile.
   

  

 We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served.

d65a1c60.title: Technical Program Manager – Data Center Infrastructure Deployments
d65a1c60.description:
**About Nebius** 




  





 Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full\-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in\-house AI/ML infrastructure.
 



 Built by engineers, for engineers. From large\-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
 



 Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R\&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500\+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R\&D.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 As a Technical Program Manager, you will own the delivery of a defined workstream within large\-scale GPU and data center infrastructure deployment programs. In this role you’ll be responsible for tracking progress, managing dependencies, and ensuring your workstream is delivered on time and at quality.
 



 This is a hands\-on role at the intersection of infrastructure, execution, and coordination, with strong exposure to real\-world data center delivery.
 



 Travel: On\-site presence at data centers will be required during key deployment phases.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities Will Include** 




  




* Own delivery of a defined workstream within a larger data center or infrastructure program.
* Track scope, schedule, and dependencies, escalating risks when needed.
* Coordinate with engineering, networking, construction, and operations teams.
* Maintain clear and structured reporting on progress, risks, and blockers.
* Support vendor and contractor coordination within your scope.
* Work closely with the Senior TPM to align on priorities and execution approach.



  





**Technical Scope \& Expectations** 




  





 This role requires exposure to physical infrastructure environments, not only software\-based projects.
 



  





**You Should Be Comfortable Working With Or Learning About** 




  




* Data center environments: basic understanding of infrastructure readiness (power, cooling, space, networking dependencies).
* Compute infrastructure: knowledge about server and storage equipment.
* Networking: cabling, connectivity, and integration dependencies.
* Deployment \& bring\-up: understanding how systems move from installation to operational readiness.



 You are not expected to be an expert, but you should:
 


* Be willing to learn technical concepts quickly.
* Understand how different parts of infrastructure depend on each other.
* Identify when something is not ready or at risk and escalate appropriately.
* Communicate effectively with technical teams.



  





**We Expect You To Have** 




  




* 2–5 years of experience in program management, operations, or technical coordination roles.
* Ability to organize work, track progress, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* communication skills and ability to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Structured thinking and attention to details.
* Willingness to learn and grow in a fast\-paced, technical environment.



  





**It will be an added bonus if you have** 




  




* Exposure to data center, networking, or hardware\-related projects,
* Familiarity with program management tools (Jira, Asana, etc.),
* Understanding of cloud environments infrastructure,
* Certifications or coursework in program management.



  





**Benefits \& Perks** 




  




* Competitive compensation
* Career growth and learning opportunities
* Flexibility and ownership
* Collaborative and innovative culture
* Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
* International environment and talented teams



  





**What's It Like To Work At Nebius** 




  





 Fast moving \- Bold thinking \- Constant growth \- Meaningful impact \- Trust and real ownership \- Opportunity to shape the future of AI
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
 



 Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.
 



 If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.
