6cf37121.title: Solutions Engineer
6cf37121.description:
**Meet the Team**
 You will be part of Cisco's Technical Sales organization, serving as a trusted advisor to customers and partners while representing Cisco’s industry\-leading portfolio across Networking, Security, Cloud, Collaboration, AI, and emerging technologies. The team works closely with account managers, business entities, partners, and customers to deliver innovative solutions that address complex business challenges and drive customer success.
   

  

 As a technical sales professional, you will own the technical relationship with customers and partners, helping them achieve their business outcomes through Cisco’s technology portfolio. You will collaborate across sales teams, technical experts, and stakeholders to identify opportunities, design solutions, and expand Cisco's footprint within strategic accounts.
   

  

**Your Impact**
**Role**
 As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will play a critical role in driving customer success and business growth by aligning technology solutions with customer objectives. You will:
   

  

* Collaborate with account teams to develop and execute customer account strategies, identifying opportunities for growth, cross\-selling, and upselling.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Translate customer business requirements into technical solutions leveraging Cisco’s full portfolio.
* Design, present, and demonstrate solutions that showcase the business value and technical capabilities of Cisco technologies.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with technical and business decision\-makers across customer organizations.
* Lead customer engagements and strategic discussions with IT leaders and line\-of\-business stakeholders.
* Identify customer challenges and tailor solutions that address specific business and technical requirements.
* Drive technical aspects of the sales cycle, from opportunity qualification through solution design and deal closure.
* Manage and coordinate virtual teams of technical resources to support customer opportunities.
* Participate in demand generation, enablement programs, and customer\-facing campaigns.
* Proactively monitor market trends and competitive activity to position Cisco effectively and increase market share.
* Collaborate with internal business entities and sales teams to provide customer feedback, market insights, and strategic recommendations.
* Lead educational and enablement initiatives to increase awareness and adoption of Cisco solutions among customers, partners, and stakeholders.
* Adapt and prioritize effectively within a dynamic and evolving sales environment.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 8\+ years of experience in technical pre\-sales, solution engineering, or customer\-facing technical sales roles.
* Proven experience leading customer engagements and technical sales cycles.
* Strong understanding of enterprise technology domains including Networking, Security, Cloud, Collaboration, and AI.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience delivering technical presentations, demonstrations, and solution workshops to customers and partners.
* Strong customer engagement, communication, and relationship management skills.
* Proven ability to collaborate across cross\-functional teams and influence stakeholders.
* Commercial awareness with a strong focus on customer success and business outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Industry certifications such as CCIE, CCNP, or equivalent vendor certifications.
* Solution design and architecture experience across Networking, Security, Cloud, AI, Collaboration, and related technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise and strategic accounts.
* Strong competitive positioning and market analysis capabilities.
* Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, market share expansion, and customer acquisition.
* Self\-motivated professional capable of operating effectively in a fast\-paced and highly collaborative environment.
* Experience leading virtual technical teams and mentoring peers.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and strategic planning skills.


 Success Measures
   

  

* Growth in revenue through successful conversion of opportunities into closed deals.
* Increased penetration within existing accounts through cross\-selling and upselling.
* Expansion of Cisco market share through competitive displacement.
* Acquisition of new customers and development of long\-term strategic relationships.
* Customer satisfaction and successful achievement of customer business outcomes.
* Effective collaboration across sales, technical, and partner ecosystems.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

7c59e804.description:
**Job Description:**
 The VKS Application Engineering team is responsible for enabling enterprise success with VMware Kubernetes Service (VKS) as part of VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF). Our mission is to accelerate adoption of VKS as the enterprise\-grade Kubernetes platform for modern applications in private cloud.
   

  

 As a VKS Application Engineer, you will be on the front lines with enterprise customers, driving the successful adoption of VMware Kubernetes Service (vKS) on VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF). This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role focused on designing and validating solutions, running proof\-of\-concepts, and guiding customers through their modernization journey.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Act as a trusted advisor for enterprise customers, guiding them through the design, validation, and deployment of vKS solutions on VCF.
* Collaborate closely with field account teams to align solution architecture with customer priorities and drive successful engagement outcomes.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, workshops, and proof\-of\-concepts to validate vKS architectures and demonstrate business value.
* Partner with sales to jointly develop customer proposals that address modernization goals, workload placement, and operational transformation.
* Provide prescriptive guidance on Kubernetes adoption, DevOps/CI\-CD integration, and enterprise requirements such as scalability, security, and disaster recovery.
* Build and share reference architectures, deployment patterns, and technical assets to accelerate customer adoption of VKS.
* Deliver clear, compelling technical presentations to diverse audiences, from architects to executive decision makers.
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor offerings, and evolving enterprise requirements to position VKS effectively.
* Collaborate with product management and engineering to provide field feedback that influences roadmap direction.

* Experience in application engineering or technical sales for enterprise IT, cloud, or application platforms.
* Strong expertise in Kubernetes, containers, and VMware Cloud Foundation (vSphere, vSAN, NSX as foundation).
* 10\+ years in technology\-related roles, with depth in enterprise IT architecture, application modernization, or cloud\-native platforms.
* Demonstrated success working directly with enterprise customers to deliver technical solutions and drive platform adoption.
* Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and business leaders.
* Strong collaboration skills, able to work hand\-in\-hand with sales teams to advance customer opportunities.
* Proven ability to identify challenges, design solutions, and articulate value in business terms.
* Enthusiastic self\-starter with curiosity, drive, and the ability to thrive in dynamic environments.

**Qualifications**

9daff70f.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The Cloud Engineer, focused on cloud data platforms and integration, is responsible for building, supporting, and maintaining scalable cloud\-based data solutions across Azure and AWS. This role provides hands\-on engineering support for Databricks, data transformation, API ingestion, and cloud\-native services while following enterprise standards for security, reliability, governance, and cost efficiency. The Cloud Engineer partners with technical teams and business stakeholders to enable trusted data delivery for reporting, analytics, AI, and operational decision\-making. * Follow engineering standards, governance practices, and deployment processes for secure and scalable delivery.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of experience in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems integration, or related technical roles.

* Experience developing or consuming REST APIs for data ingestion and enterprise system integration.
* Experience building or supporting cloud\-native solutions within Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).

**Preferred Qualifications**

6a996afb.title: Delivery Manager
6a996afb.description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 08/20/2026
* Job Type Permanent
* Industry IT Services
* Work Experience 10\-15 Years
* City Pune
* State/Province Maharashtra
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 411057
### **About Us**


**CCTech**'s mission is to transform human life by the democratization of technology. We are a well established digital transformation company building the applications in the areas of CAD, CFD, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, 3D Webapps, Augmented Reality, Digital Twin, and other enterprise applications.
  

We have two business divisions: product and consulting.  


simulationHub is our flagship product and the manifestation of our vision. Currently, thousands of users use our CFD app in their upfront design process.
  

Our consulting division, with its partners such as Autodesk Forge, AWS and Azure, is helping the world's leading engineering organizations, many of which are Fortune 500 list of companies, in achieving digital supremacy.  

  

### **Job Description**


**Role Overview**  

  

We are looking for an experienced Delivery Manager to own end\-to\-end delivery of multiple concurrent turnkey engineering software projects. This role requires a strong blend of technical program management, client relationship management, and team leadership to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the quality standards our clients expect. The ideal candidate has managed multiple software/product engineering projects simultaneously in a services or turnkey delivery environment.  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

  

**Multi\-Project Delivery Management**  

* Own delivery of 4–8 concurrent turnkey engineering software projects across CAD/BIM, Cloud, Data \& AI, or Digital Twin domains.
* Define project plans, resourcing, milestones, and delivery roadmaps in collaboration with technical leads and architects.
* Track scope, schedule, budget, and quality (SQBC) across all projects; proactively flag risks and drive mitigation.
* Ensure adherence to SDLC/Agile processes, coding standards, and QA gates across teams.

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**  

* Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders on project status, escalations, and roadmap discussions.
* Run governance cadences — status calls, steering committee reviews, QBRs — with clients across geographies (India/US/Middle East time zones).
* Manage scope changes (change requests, SOWs) and contract renewals in coordination with sales/account teams.

  

**Team \& Resource Management**  

* Lead and mentor project leads, tech leads, and cross\-functional engineering teams (developers, QA, architects) assigned across projects.
* Plan resource allocation and utilization across projects; work with talent acquisition on hiring/staffing needs.
* Conduct performance reviews, career development planning, and capability building for delivery teams.

**Process \& Governance**  

* Establish and continuously improve delivery frameworks, PMO processes, and reporting dashboards (RAID logs, burn\-down, utilization, margin tracking).
* Ensure project profitability by tracking effort vs. estimate, managing scope creep, and optimizing resource utilization.
* Drive knowledge management and reusable frameworks/accelerators across projects to improve delivery efficiency.

**Risk \& Escalation Management**  

* Identify delivery risks early (technical, resourcing, scope, client relationship) and drive resolution.
* Own escalation management, ensuring timely and transparent communication to leadership and clients.

### **Requirements**

* 10–15 years total experience in software/IT services, with at least 4–6 years as a Delivery Manager / Program Manager / Senior Project Manager managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Proven experience delivering turnkey/fixed\-scope software engineering projects for global (preferably US/Europe) clients.
* Strong understanding of software engineering practices — Agile/Scrum, DevOps, QA/testing, cloud deployment (AWS preferred).
* Experience managing engineering/CAD/BIM/CFD/simulation software projects is a strong plus (domain exposure to Autodesk Platform Services, PLM/BIM, or engineering simulation preferred but not mandatory).
* Demonstrated ability to manage P\&L/margins for projects, including resource planning, estimation, and utilization tracking.
* Excellent client\-facing communication skills; experience handling escalations and steering committee discussions with senior client stakeholders.
* Strong people leadership — managing and growing teams of 30–100\+ engineers across multiple projects.
* PMP / PRINCE2 / CSM / SAFe certification preferred.
* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field; MBA is a plus.

### **Benefits**

* Opportunity to lead delivery for marquee global engineering brands.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge technology — Cloud, AI, Digital Twin, CAD/BIM platforms.
* Flat, collaborative culture with strong learning \& development support.
* Competitive compensation and growth path to Head of Delivery / BU Head roles.

5fbc58c8.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
5fbc58c8.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager
   

  

**Overview**
* The Decision Management program enables intelligent decision\-based products through streaming analytics with the ability to govern decisions and manage outcomes with business agility.
* This program leverages business rules and AI engines, streaming big data platforms, in\-memory data grids, APIs, cloud\-native services, and modern user interfaces to deliver real\-time decisions at global scale.
* This role is responsible for driving large\-scale cross\-functional programs, aligning engineering, product, data science, and business stakeholders, and ensuring successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
* The Technical Program Manager will provide leadership across multiple teams, help define execution strategy, identify and mitigate risks, and drive operational excellence across the program lifecycle.


 We are looking for a \*\*Technical Program Manager\*\* to join our Decision Management Platform (DMP) team.
   

  

* Are you passionate about driving complex technical programs from conception to delivery?
* Do you enjoy collaborating with engineering, product, architecture, operations, and business stakeholders to achieve strategic outcomes?
* Are you excited about working on large\-scale, mission\-critical systems that process millions of transactions in real time?
* Do you want to play a key role in helping prevent fraud and enable intelligent decisioning across Mastercard products worldwide?


 Role
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of strategic technical programs across multiple engineering teams.
* Define program scope, objectives, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering Managers, Architects, Data Scientists, and Business stakeholders to deliver business outcomes.
* Drive planning, execution, risk management, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication.
* Establish and maintain program governance, reporting, and executive\-level status updates.
* Facilitate technical discussions and support architectural decision\-making across teams.
* Identify program risks early and drive mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery.
* Coordinate platform modernization, cloud migration, AI/ML enablement, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Lead Agile planning activities, including roadmap reviews, PI planning, sprint tracking, and release coordination.
* Monitor program health, delivery metrics, capacity planning, and resource utilization.
* Ensure alignment with security, compliance, reliability, and quality standards.
* Foster collaboration and drive continuous improvement across engineering and product organizations.
* Support incident management, postmortem reviews, and execution of corrective actions when required.


**Essential Knowledge / Experience**
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile delivery methodologies.
* Experience managing large\-scale distributed systems, cloud\-native platforms, enterprise applications, and modern engineering architectures.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional programs involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Strong experience in program planning, roadmap management, dependency management, and risk mitigation.
* Experience working with Agile frameworks such as Scrum, SAFe, or Kanban.
* Strong understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and platform operations.
* Experience with cloud technologies
* Experience tracking and reporting program metrics, KPIs, and operational health indicators.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive\-level presentations.
* Experience managing technical dependencies across engineering, product, infrastructure, and operations teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across diverse teams.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Experience using project and program management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.


 Desirable Skills
   

  

* Experience delivering AI/ML, data platform, or advanced analytics programs.
* Knowledge of business rules technologies such as IBM ODM/ILOG.
* Experience with distributed data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and in\-memory data grids (GemFire, Redis, etc.).
* Knowledge of observability and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana, or Prometheus.
* Experience managing cloud migration, platform modernization, or large\-scale transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of cybersecurity, secure software development practices, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* PMP, PgMP, PMI\-ACP, SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), SAFe Agilist, or equivalent certification preferred.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.


 Key Success Measures
   

  

* Successful delivery of strategic programs on time and within scope.
* Effective management of cross\-team dependencies and risks.
* Improved engineering productivity, predictability, and operational excellence.
* High stakeholder satisfaction and alignment across business and technology organizations.
* Measurable impact on platform scalability, reliability, modernization, and business outcomes.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

ed0a4d18.title: Senior Atlassian Consultant – Cloud and AI
ed0a4d18.description:
**Senior Atlassian Consultant – Cloud \& AI**


**Experience:** 5–8 Years


**About the Role**



We are looking for a highly skilled **Senior Atlassian Consultant** with expertise in **Atlassian Cloud, Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), Confluence, automation, and AI\-powered collaboration**. The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing, implementing, administering, and optimizing Atlassian solutions while leveraging **Atlassian Rovo** and modern AI capabilities to improve productivity, knowledge discovery, and enterprise collaboration.



The role requires close collaboration with customers, presales teams, and internal stakeholders to design scalable Atlassian solutions, implement best practices, and deliver business value through Cloud\-first architectures.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Atlassian Cloud Administration**


* Administer and support Atlassian Cloud products including Jira Software, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence.
* Configure and maintain projects, workflows, issue types, screens, permissions, notification schemes, automation rules, and dashboards.
* Design scalable and maintainable Atlassian solutions aligned with customer business processes.
* Perform Atlassian Cloud implementations, upgrades, optimization, and platform governance.
* Experience planning and executing Data Center to Cloud and Cloud\-to\-Cloud migrations.
* Perform migration assessments covering applications, configurations, users/groups, integrations, and Marketplace apps.
* Support migration planning, test migrations, validation, cutover, and post\-migration stabilization.
* Experience with popular marketplace apps. Experience with various reporting tools.
* Experience with Marketplace applications such as ScriptRunner, Xray, Zephyr, Tempo, BigPicture, EazyBI, Insight/Assets, etc.
* Experience with Atlassian Administration, Atlassian Guard, SAML SSO, SCIM/user provisioning, authentication policies, user/group management, and enterprise access controls.


**AI \& Atlassian Rovo**


* Design and implement AI\-powered solutions using **Atlassian Rovo**.
* Configure and optimize **Rovo Chat**, **Rovo Search**, and **Rovo Agents** for enterprise use cases.
* Develop and optimize prompts to improve AI\-assisted workflows and user productivity.
* Build and configure **Rovo Skills** and **Actions** to automate business processes.
* Curate enterprise knowledge sources to improve search relevance and AI\-generated responses.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Atlassian Intelligence and AI features to improve collaboration and operational efficiency.


**Solution Design \& Consulting**


* Work closely with customers to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Atlassian solutions.
* Participate in customer technical discussions, workshops, demonstrations, and solution presentations.
* Collaborate with the Presales team for solution design, effort estimation, and technical proposal preparation.
* Recommend best practices for Atlassian architecture, governance, security, and scalability.


**Automation \& Integrations**


* Design and implement automation using Jira Automation, REST APIs, Groovy, Python, or PowerShell.
* Integrate Atlassian products with enterprise applications and third\-party tools.
* Develop reusable automation solutions to improve operational efficiency.
* Configure advanced workflows, custom fields, forms, request types, SLAs, and reporting.


**Platform Governance \& Security**


* Implement governance standards across Atlassian products.
* Configure user management, access controls, security settings, and permission schemes.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards and best practices.
* Monitor platform performance and recommend continuous improvements.


**Documentation \& Knowledge Management**


* Prepare technical documentation, implementation guides, architecture documents, and operational runbooks.
* Conduct administrator and end\-user training sessions.
* Mentor junior consultants and share Atlassian best practices across teams.


**Required Skills \& Experience**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of hands\-on experience administering Atlassian products including Jira, Jira Service Management, Asset, Atlassian Guard and Confluence.
* Strong experience with Atlassian Cloud administration and solution implementation.
* Expertise in configuring workflows, schemes, automation, dashboards, permissions, and integrations.
* Hands\-on experience with Rovo Chat, Rovo Search, and Rovo Agents, Rovo Skills and Actions.
* Experience in prompt engineering, AI\-assisted workflow design, and prompt optimization.
* Experience curating and managing enterprise knowledge sources for AI search and knowledge discovery.
* Strong scripting skills using Groovy, Python, PowerShell, or REST APIs.
* Experience integrating Atlassian products with enterprise applications.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with ITSM best practices and Agile methodologies.


**Good to Have**


* Conceptual understanding of **Forge** and the ability to identify when Forge is more suitable than native Atlassian configuration or Marketplace applications.
* Atlassian certifications (ACP) are preferred.


**Preferred Candidate Profile**


* Strong customer\-facing consulting experience.
* Excellent presentation and solutioning skills.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Experience working with enterprise customers across multiple industries.
* Passion for AI\-driven productivity and continuous learning within the Atlassian ecosystem.
* Ability to mentor junior consultants and contribute to organizational capability building.


**Why Join Us?**


* Work on enterprise\-scale Atlassian Cloud transformation programs.
* Build innovative AI\-powered solutions using Atlassian Rovo.
* Collaborate with global customers and cross\-functional teams.
* Opportunity to work with the latest Atlassian Cloud, AI, automation, and integration technologies.
* Continuous learning, certification support, and career growth opportunities.


**Important Eligibility Note**



* Candidates whose experience has been exclusively with **Atlassian Data Center/Server** and who do not have hands\-on exposure to **Atlassian Cloud** should not apply.


* Candidates whose experience is limited to **basic Jira administration** without understanding business processes, requirement gathering, solution design, or translating business needs into Atlassian solutions should not apply.

 We are seeking a Sr. Solution Advisor to join our Supply Chain Advisory team. The Sr. Solution Advisor will support the development and delivery of customer\-focused, cost\-effective, and innovative supply chain solutions. This role contributes to customer satisfaction and success by supporting solution design, delivering insights, and assisting in the deployment of tailored Retail planning and optimization capabilities aligned to customer business needs.

 **Merchandise Financial Planning, S\&OP** 
 ,
 **Assortment Planning, Demand Planning, Allocation \& Replenishment Planning and Order management** 
 . Require Industry consultative selling skills to prescribe advanced SAAS solutions to specific business requirements, demonstrating how AI/ML enabled Retail Planning solutions will optimize financial plans, category assortments, channel inventory and provide real\-time visibility. **Key Skills**

* Ability to lead a blueprinting exercise.
* Ability to deliver Blue Yonder demo using business stories, business impact, and differentiation; can support tag changes and data uploads to support customer demos.
* Demonstrates in\-depth solution functionality across one or many solutions; can tailor use cases to client priorities.
* Skilled at connecting configuration decisions to operational and financial outcomes.
* Maintains competitive differentiation knowledge and can effectively position Blue Yonder as a market leader.
* Understands technical architecture, APIs, and integration strategy within the broader enterprise ecosystem.
* Ability to align data flows, interoperability, and system design to ensure scalability.
* Skilled in linking technology design to business KPIs.
* Serves as a trusted advisor in process transformation discussions; guides customers through workflows, ensures alignment to reference architectures, and supports design authority governance during implementations.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Retail Business or related field.
* A minimum of 6 years of experience in a customer\-facing Omni channel Retail planning solution advisor or consultative sales role.
* Proven track record of developing and delivering customer\-centric solutions that drive measurable impact.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills, with ability to influence both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to think creatively, strategize, and execute in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Strong customer focus and commitment to exceeding customer expectations.

 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

 A Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights, driving strategic business outcomes. Serving over 30,000 global customers, our portfolio leverages pervasive data quality and advanced AI/ML capabilities that lead to better decisions, faster.
   

  

 We excel in integration and governance solutions that work with diverse data sources, and our real\-time analytics uncover hidden patterns, empowering teams to address complex challenges and seize new opportunities.
   

  

**The Principal Solution Architect Role**
 Are you ready to take the lead in shaping the future of data and analytics? As a Senior Solution Architect, you’ll be the go\-to technical expert, guiding some of the largest customers and partners in the India region. You’ll be at the forefront of demonstrating how cutting\-edge data integration and analytics solutions can drive real business transformation.
   

  

 Collaborating closely with a dynamic Presales team in a flexible, agile environment, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your expertise while working with Sales, Marketing, R\&D, Product, Consulting, and Customer Success teams. If you're looking for a role that is engaging, fast\-paced, and full of opportunities to make an impact, this is it.
   

  

**What makes this role interesting?**
* Engage with high\-profile customers and partners: Lead technical discussions and showcase innovative solutions to help organizations unlock the true power of their data.
* Drive business success with cutting\-edge technology: Leverage Qlik’s next\-generation data analytics and data integration platform to solve complex business challenges.
* Be at the forefront of industry trends: Stay ahead of the game by keeping up with the latest advancements in data analytics, as well as the competitive landscape.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams: Work closely with internal teams and experts across Sales, Marketing, R\&D, and Customer Success to build compelling solutions that resonate with customers.
* Flexibility and agility: Thrive in an environment that values adaptability, innovation, and dynamic thinking.


**Here’s How You’ll Be Making An Impact**
* Own the technical sales cycle: Become a trusted advisor by guiding customers through technical evaluations, ensuring a seamless journey from exploration to adoption.
* Showcase innovation through tailored solutions: Deliver compelling presentations and custom demonstrations that address real customer needs and business challenges.
* Prove value through successful Proof\-of\-Concepts: Help customers experience the true power of Qlik’s platform by leading impactful proof\-of\-concept engagements.
* Support business development efforts: Play a key role in driving regional revenue growth by supporting strategic sales initiatives and expanding Qlik’s presence in the market.
* Position solutions for long\-term success: Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from technical teams to senior leadership, ensuring alignment on the value and impact of Qlik’s solutions.


**We’re Looking For a Teammate With**
* At least 6 years of experience in a presales and/or consulting capacity
* Strong experience in Data Integration (ETL), Data Quality (DQ), Data Governance, iPaaS (APIs, micro services, Application Integration) will be plus
* Good understanding of SQL \& data modeling.
* Good understanding of Machine Learning tools and its usage such as Python/R, and other AI/ML and Gen AI technologies
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and services

* Excellent communication skills to the business as well as technical audience
* Highly driven with strong interpersonal skills
* Track record of developing relationships at technical, commercial, and executive levels throughout large enterprises

 Delhi, India (travel required across the country as necessary).

16e16fbc.title: Customer Engagement And AI Domain Architect, Director
16e16fbc.description:
Closing date for applications: 30/08/2026



Location Chennai, India


Job typePermanent \| Contract typeFull Time


\#R\-00283839

  



**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------


In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.


So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.


**Job description**
-------------------


This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.


Join us as a Customer Engagement And AI Domain Architect


* We’ll look to you to define the strategic target architecture and roadmap, aligning them with business strategy and objectives
* You'll be facilitating collaborative architecture decision making, partnering and engaging with key business and digital leaders to continually evolve the bank’s long term architectural direction
* With valuable exposure, you’ll cultivate strong relationships and proactively engage with key stakeholders, including business and technology leaders, vendors and partners, and industry thought leaders
* We're offering this role at director level

**What you'll do**
------------------


As a Customer Engagement And AI Domain Architect, you’ll architect customer centric, high performance, secure, robust and sustainable end to end digital products, solutions, and services that deliver business value while aligning to the bank’s strategic target architecture. You'll lead the strategy, architecture, and transformation of customer engagement capabilities by defining target\-state architectures, AI\-first roadmaps, and governance frameworks that simplify operations, enhance process efficiency, and align with enterprise data, security, cloud, and technology strategies. You'll provide design authority for large\-scale initiatives, delivering scalable and resilient solutions while driving workflow orchestration, intelligent automation, straight\-through processing, and Responsible AI governance.


You'll architect AI\-powered customer and colleague experiences through CRM, agentic AI, and enterprise AI capabilities that enable hyper\-personalization, improve productivity, and strengthen operational resilience. You'll also lead enterprise modernization and integration efforts across CRM, digital, data, workflow, and core platforms, driving technology consolidation, operational simplification, stakeholder alignment, and adoption of AI\-first, customer\-centric ways of working.


As well as this, you’ll be:


* Leading architecture and design reviews of solution architectures within delivery programmes of high architectural significance or risk
* Inspecting and verifying that proposed designs meet business needs, and are compliant with Architecture Council approved architecture principles, standards, and patterns
* Driving technology innovation by identifying and evaluating emerging technologies and their potential impact on the bank
* Actively shaping and contributing to strategic investment programmes, identifying opportunities for simplification or reuse, and guiding programme design to build and adopt the key architecture enablers
* Promoting a DevOps mindset by working as part of development teams to embed architecture guidance in CI/CD pipelines
* Continuously researching and evaluating emerging technologies, architecture patterns, and industry best practices to identify threats to current architecture and opportunities for innovation and competitive advantage

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------


To succeed in this role, you’ll need expert knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks, modern technologies such as Cloud, microservices and AI, agile architecture and DevOps practices, including a deep understanding of business use cases and emerging trends that drive organisational success. You'll need at least eighteen years of total experience with proven expertise in Enterprise and Solution Architecture leadership, defining target\-state architectures, capability roadmaps, governance frameworks, and enterprise technology strategies, with deep knowledge of cloud\-native, API\-first, event\-driven, and scalable platform architectures.


You'll bring strong expertise in customer engagement platforms, particularly Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, and Agentic AI frameworks, with experience designing AI\-powered customer and colleague experiences while driving operational simplification through automation and process redesign. You'll need experience in providing architectural leadership for enterprise transformation initiatives, driving governance, stakeholder alignment, and strategic technology decisions that deliver measurable business value, enhance customer experiences, and improve operational efficiency across the organization.


You’ll also demonstrate:


* Experience of leading collaborative decision\-making processes, partnering with senior business and technology colleagues to articulate and evolve architectural direction
* Experience of identifying and advocating for strategic investment opportunities that enhance the organisation's architecture goals
* The proven ability to craft compelling business cases and influence senior stakeholders to secure investment for architecture initiatives
* Extensive experience of overseeing and assuring the quality of architecture designs, with a focus on risk management and governance
* Experience of conducting comprehensive architecture and design reviews to validate that solutions meet business needs and comply with architecture standards
* A proven track record of fostering a culture of architectural excellence through mentorship and knowledge sharing

**Welcome to our Chennai hub**
------------------------------


Nestled in the heart of One India Bulls Park, our hub in Kosmo One, Tower A, is one of Ambattur’s first skyscraper spanning 420,000 sq. ft.


### **Key facts:**


* Surrounded by 10 acres
* Space for 3,600 colleagues
* Opened in 2009
### **Our tech stack**


Here’s just some of the technologies we use.


### **Front end**


* JavaScript
* ReactJS
* AngularJS
### **Back end**


* Python
* Java
* Microsoft Dynamics
### **DevOps**


* AWS
* GitLab
* Google Cloud Platform
### **Data**


* Kafka
* Hadoop
* PostgreSQL
* Snowflake

* Design and configure enterprise routing and switching infrastructure using Cisco technologies
* Manage LAN/WAN network design, implementation, and optimization across multi\-site environments
* Configure and troubleshoot advanced network protocols including BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP
* Conduct network security assessments and create detailed technical specifications and design documents
* Perform advanced troubleshooting of complex network and security issues across distributed environments
* Support network security implementations including access control, segmentation, and threat mitigation
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including systems engineers, security, and infrastructure teams
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of network configurations, topologies, and runbooks
* Stay current with emerging network and security technologies and industry best practices
* Provide technical leadership during client engagements and solution design phases

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in enterprise network engineering
* 5\+ years of demonstrated expertise in Palo Alto Networks firewall administration and deployment
* 5\+ years of experience with F5 LTM/GTM load balancing technologies
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with Cisco routing and switching infrastructure
* 3\+ years of experience designing and implementing LAN/WAN networks
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP routing protocols
* Proven experience with network security architecture and implementation
* Experience with network monitoring, analytics, and performance optimization tools

**Technical Skills**

* Palo Alto Networks (PAN\-OS, Panorama, threat prevention, security policies)
* F5 LTM/GTM (virtual servers, pools, iRules, traffic policies, failover)
* Cisco routing and switching (IOS\-XE, IOS\-XR, NX\-OS)
* LAN/WAN design and implementation (MPLS, VPN, QoS)
* Network protocols: BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLAN, VPN, QoS
* Network security: firewalls, intrusion prevention, threat detection, DLP
* Network automation and scripting (Python, Ansible, Terraform preferred)
* Cloud networking and hybrid infrastructure
* Network monitoring tools (Splunk, Datadog, Palo Alto Cortex, F5 Analytics)
* Multi\-vendor environments and interoperability

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE)
* Palo Alto Networks Certified Associate (PCSA)
* F5 Certified Technology Specialist (F5\-CTS) \- LTM or GTM
* Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) \- Enterprise or Routing \& Switching
* Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) \- Routing \& Switching or Enterprise
* CompTIA Security\+ or equivalent security certification

83db1dbc.title: IT Operations Readiness Solution Architect - Pune
83db1dbc.description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------



We are seeking an IT Operations Readiness Solution Architect to ensure new services, applications, infrastructure changes and technology transformations are ready for production deployment, acting as a key connection point between Project, Engineering, Development, Vendor and Operations teams.


**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Lead Operational Readiness Reviews and define Operational Acceptance Criteria.
* Coordinate go\-live readiness, Go/No\-Go meetings, hypercare planning and exit criteria.
* Define support models, RACI, escalation paths, SLAs, KPIs and governance reviews.
* Ensure monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards and service health visibility are in place.
* Validate incident, problem, change, recovery, runbook and knowledge management readiness.
* Review capacity, performance, resilience, DR, BCP and scalability requirements.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Experienced in IT Operations, Service Management, SRE or Application Support.
* Skilled in Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Transition processes.
* Confident managing production go\-lives and large\-scale transformations.
* Knowledgeable in ITIL, operational governance, risk management and stakeholder communication.
* Familiar with tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana or AppDynamics.
* Experience in telecom OSS/BSS, Managed Services, Oracle, CRM, Middleware, Cloud or Digital platforms would be an advantage.
**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to contribute to reliable production deployments and smooth service transitions.
* Exposure to cross\-functional delivery across technology, operations, engineering and vendor teams.
* Ability to influence operational governance, service reliability and launch readiness practices.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Advanced operational readiness and service transition governance.
* Hypercare management, production go\-live planning and risk mitigation.
* Practical experience with observability, resilience, support models and ITIL\-aligned operations.
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------



Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------



At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

---------

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
  

\#JDEnhancedByTARA

-----------------------------

79388d42.description:
**Requisition Number:** **105862**

**Cloud Engineer III \- Cloud Infra/DevOps**

 **Location**: Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune. This is a hybrid work opportunity.  

**Shift\- 2 PM\- 11 PM or 3 PM\- 12 AM IST, based on client requirement.**

 **I****nsight at a Glance**

* 14,000\+ engaged teammates globally with operations in 25 countries across the globe.
* Received 35\+ industry and partner awards in the past year
* $9\.2 billion in revenue
* \#20 on Fortune’s World's Best Workplaces™ list
* \#14 on Forbes World's Best Employers in IT
* \#23 on Forbes Best Employers for Women in IT
  

Now is the time to bring your expertise to Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people\-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organizations through complex digital decisions.

 **About the role**


As a Cloud Engineer III, you will be part of the consulting and delivery practice, utilizing cutting\-edge automation tools and provisioning in public cloud providers—preferably Azure or AWS. You will be responsible for designing and deploying well\-architected cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience in customer\-facing roles and a proven track record of delivering cloud solutions with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) automation on various projects. Along the way, you will:

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and manage cloud infrastructure resources across AWS and Azure, including virtual machines, storage, networking, and databases.
* Support the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high\-performing cloud solutions in collaboration with senior engineers and architects.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, PowerShell, ARM templates, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins to automate application and infrastructure deployments.
* Deploy and manage containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS/EKS).
* Configure monitoring and observability solutions using tools such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic.
* Support cloud migration initiatives using tools such as Azure Migrate and assist with disaster recovery and BCDR implementations.
* Perform troubleshooting, performance optimization, and cost optimization across cloud environments.
* Implement cloud security best practices including identity and access management (IAM), network security, and encryption.
* Collaborate with internal teams and client stakeholders in Agile/Scrum environments to support successful project delivery.
 **Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or related roles.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one public cloud platform (AWS or Azure), with basic exposure to the other being a plus.
* Experience with core cloud infrastructure services including:
* Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VNet, Azure Storage, Azure Monitor, Azure AD, Load Balancers, DNS, and Application Gateway.
* AWS: EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Elastic Load Balancers, and Auto Scaling.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM/Bicep, PowerShell, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Experience with CI/CD tools and version control systems such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Git, GitHub, or Azure Repos.
* Experience with Linux/Unix and Windows environments, including system troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker containers and Kubernetes (AKS or EKS).
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Azure Monitor, or AWS CloudWatch.
* Exposure to cloud migration tools (Azure Migrate or similar) and understanding of BCDR concepts.
* Experience deploying and managing applications in cloud\-based production environments.
* Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, or similar are a plus.
 **Professional Attributes**

* Demonstrates high integrity with a proactive and positive approach to work.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional and team\-oriented environments.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with a focus on delivering practical solutions.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and tasks effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to continuously learn, adapt, and take on new challenges.

Join us as a Vice President \- Solution Architect at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Vice President \- Solution Architect at Barclays you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Strong experience in creating technical documents such E2E Design / High Level Design / Architectural Vision.
* Strong experience in relevant technologies (Java/.Net/Mainframe/DB2/MSSQL).
* Experience in application integration technologies (MQ, C:D, APIs).
* Experience in application infrastructure both on premises, external, and Public Cloud (AWS).
* Experience in Project Management both Agile and Waterfall.
* Able to demonstrate previous evidence of drive, energy, commitment and enthusiasm.
* Experienced technical Solution Architect.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Understanding of Trade and Working Capital domain.
* Professional certifications e.g. TOGAF.
* Experience with financial instruments deposits, loans, and treasury.
* Strong data and database architecture expertise across enterprise relational and NoSQL platforms.
* Proven leadership in regulatory driven design, ensuring auditability, traceability, model transparency, and compliance (e.g., Basel III).
* Understanding of Banking and Financial Services Industry.


 Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership, including mentoring architects, influencing roadmaps, and driving cross functional alignment.
   

  

 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures.
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

d2d40cf9.title: Business Architect
d2d40cf9.description:
**Project Role :** Business Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Identify opportunities to deliver tangible business value by assessing the current state, capturing high\-level requirements, and defining business solutions. Translate business needs into technology\-enabled solutions and operating models. Support transformation by developing business cases and guiding implementation of key initiatives.
  

**Must have skills :** Business Requirements Analysis  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **12** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary
  

As a Proxy Product Manager, you will be responsible for supporting product strategy, roadmap planning, backlog management, and delivery across cross\-functional engineering teams. You will act as a bridge between Product Managers, Product Owners, business stakeholders, engineering, architecture, and QA teams, ensuring that requirements are clearly defined, prioritized, and successfully delivered.  

The role requires strong expertise in product lifecycle management, Agile methodologies, requirements engineering, stakeholder management, and delivery planning, with the ability to independently drive product decisions and priorities in alignment with the overall product vision.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:  

* Support the Product Manager in defining product vision, roadmap, priorities, and release plans.
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring effective prioritization.
* Translate business and customer needs into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with engineering, architecture, QA, UX, and business teams for successful delivery.
* Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, product reviews, and release planning.
* Analyze customer and stakeholder feedback and convert it into actionable product requirements.
* Manage dependencies, risks, priorities, and delivery commitments.
* Act as the Product Manager s representative and make day\-to\-day product decisions when required.
* Track product progress using KPIs, product metrics, and delivery dashboards.
* Ensure features meet defined business objectives, quality standards, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive alignment across multiple teams and stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Mentor Product Owners/Business Analysts and promote Agile product management practices.

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:  

  

* 10\+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Software Delivery.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Agile/Scrum, product backlog management, and SDLC.
* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of requirements engineering, user stories, acceptance criteria, prioritization, and product roadmaps.
* Experience working closely with software engineering, architecture, QA, and DevOps teams.
* Good understanding of APIs, cloud platforms, microservices, databases, and modern software architecture.
* Experience with product analytics, KPIs, dashboards, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Experience in Automotive, Embedded Software, ADAS, ECU, or connected products is an added advantage.
* Strong leadership, ownership, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management abilities.
* Strong customer and business\-outcome orientation.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, risks, and dependencies.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills across cross\-functional teams.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.

  

Additional Information:  

  

* Bachelor s or Master s degree in in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Product Management, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent certification is an added advantage.

  

15 years full time education

9404def5.description:
**THE WORK:** Explore opportunities to contribute actively and independently while becoming a subject matter expert. You will participate in discussions and collaborate to provide thoughtful solutions to work\-related challenges. This role will engage your advanced skills in Solution Architecture, fostering an environment where your expertise can truly shine. Join us in making a meaningful impact through your valuable contributions.
  
  

**Client \& Project:** We are seeking a new talent to join the Solution Architecture \& Planning team where you will have the opportunity to collaborate in the project CCaaS.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

1\. Provide pre\-sales assistance with establishing Voice communications \- CCaaS between Accenture’s Global Delivery Network(GDN) locations and client or project locations
  
2\. The SSA, acts as the primary point of contact between the Solution Support Team and the Deal Team and is responsible for gathering Voice requirements, design and costs estimation creation
  
3\. Once deal team approves proposed solution, SSA will handover solution deployment responsibility to Client deployment team.
  
4\. SSA will be responsible to answer RFP/RFI questions.

Advanced proficiency in Genesys Voice Platform.

75ed82e2.title: Technical Account Manager (EMEA)
75ed82e2.description:
**WHO ARE WE?**



We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


**CloudSEK****,** one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real\-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.



Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


**CloudSEK’s Product Suite:**


* CloudSEK **XVigil** constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
* A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's **BeVigil** uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
* CloudSEK’s Contextual AI **SVigil** identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third\-party dependencies.


**Key Milestones:**


* **2016**: Launched our first product.
* **2018**: Secured Pre\-series A funding.
* **2019**: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
* **2020**: Won the NASSCOM\-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
* **2021**: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
* **Awards \& Recognition**: Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
* **2025**: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is the primary post\-sale point of contact for assigned accounts, blending commercial ownership with hands\-on cybersecurity expertise to ensure clients realize continuous value from CloudSEK's platform. This is a travel\-intensive role requiring at least 60% travel to customer sites.



The TAM serves as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders — from security teams to CXOs, CISOs, and partners — driving engagement through QBRs/ABRs/EBRs, while also acting as a security analyst who triages platform findings, conducts configuration reviews, and delivers actionable threat intelligence. The TAM also owns the account's commercial health: driving product adoption, running product walkthroughs, identifying upsell/cross\-sell opportunities, and ensuring on\-time renewals to reduce churn and grow NRR.



Success requires balancing customer advocacy with commercial accountability, coordinating with internal teams and partners to resolve issues and close wins, and channeling client feedback into product improvement — alongside contributing to team knowledge\-sharing and training.


### **Travel Requirements**


* Extensive travel role — at least 60% travel to customer sites

### **Relationship Management \& Customer Engagement**


* Manage and nurture relationships with assigned accounts, ensuring high satisfaction and retention
* Be a trusted advisor to clients
* Develop and execute engagement strategies for key stakeholders (CXOs, CISOs, procurement teams, partners/distributors)
* Foster customer champions to drive advocacy and referrals
* Source referrals and participate in revenue generation and customer marketing events

### **Business Reviews \& Reporting**


* Conduct QBRs, ABRs, and EBRs to assess and enhance customer engagement
* Triage platform findings and report threat insights to clients frequently

  


### **Technical \& Security Advisory**


* Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and cybersecurity issues
* Act as a security analyst, offering insights/recommendations based on platform\-generated threats
* Conduct configuration reviews and provide product enhancement recommendations

### **Adoption \& Product Enablement**


* Drive 100% adoption of CloudSEK's solutions with customer security teams
* Conduct independent product walkthroughs using battlecards/collateral
* Collaborate with the POC team for quick technical and financial wins

### **Revenue Growth \& Renewals**


* Identify upsell/cross\-sell opportunities; own renewals and expansion in assigned accounts
* Collaborate with partners/distributors for smooth renewals and account expansion
* Ensure on\-time renewals to reduce churn and increase NRR every quarter

### **Feedback \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Gather and analyze customer feedback for product development
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to drive product and delivery enhancements

### **Operational \& Internal Contribution**


* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions/activities in CRM
* Share knowledge, conduct training sessions, and write internal articles

  


**What we are looking for:**


**Experience\-**


* 3\+ years of experience in the cybersecurity industry, in a client\-facing role such as Account Management, Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Security Consulting
* Proven track record of managing renewals, driving upsell/cross\-sell, and owning revenue targets (NRR/retention) for enterprise accounts
* Experience engaging with senior stakeholders (CXOs, CISOs) and navigating procurement/partner ecosystems
* Prior exposure to BFSI or other regulated\-sector clients is a plus


**Technical/Domain Knowledge\-**


* Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts — threat intelligence, digital risk protection, data leak prevention, attack surface management, or brand/fraud monitoring
* Ability to independently interpret security findings/alerts and translate them into client\-facing recommendations
* Comfortable conducting product demos, configuration reviews, and technical walkthroughs without heavy pre\-sales/engineering support
* Familiarity with SaaS security platforms and their integration into customer security workflows


**Skills\-**


* Strong executive communication and presentation skills — able to run QBRs/ABRs/EBRs with CXO/CISO audiences
* Consultative, advisory selling approach — balances customer advocacy with commercial outcomes
* Analytical mindset for triaging findings, spotting expansion opportunities, and analyzing customer feedback
* Proficiency with CRM tools for pipeline and account record management
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills


**Other Requirements\-**


* Willingness to travel extensively (60%\+) to customer sites
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, or related); relevant certifications (e.g., CEH, Security\+, CISM) are a plus but not mandatory
**Benefits of Joining CloudSEK**



We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:


* Flexible working hours.
* Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.


And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
