f286d826.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Leader- Microsoft AI Business Solutions
f286d826.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Crowe’s Microsoft AI powered Business Solutions practice brings together advisory, solution delivery, and managed services across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, data, automation, Copilot, and agentic AI. We’re doubling the practice over the next two years, and this role will play a key part in shaping how our India engineering team evolves, operates, and delivers as we grow.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, player\-coach role. You'll stay in the work — contributing to complex engagements, sitting in customer conversations, owning architecture decisions — while raising the technical bar for the team around you.
   

  

 You'll also help grow the team's range across the wider Microsoft stack — Power Platform, Azure, data, automation, Copilot, and agentic AI — combining engineering depth with business process fluency and solution architecture to help Crowe move from traditional system implementation toward AI\-enabled business process transformation, and from primarily hourly billing toward fixed\-fee, outcome\-based, and managed services delivery.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Set engineering and architecture standards for the team by translating ambiguous business problems into technical solution patterns — deciding when an agentic/AI approach is the right call versus when a simpler, deterministic solution serves the client better.
* Stay hands\-on: contribute directly to complex client engagements, own architecture decisions, and participate in customer conversations — a player\-coach role, not one that manages from a distance.
* Lead technical design and delivery of AI\-enabled business process solutions across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Dataverse, Fabric, integrations, and related enterprise technologies — including agentic workflows, copilots, automation, data enrichment, decision support, and human\-in\-the\-loop processes.
* Coach and upskill the India engineering team on modern delivery methods, architecture rigor, and critical thinking around ambiguous requirements and complex customer conversations; influence performance ratings and talent decisions.
* Identify where AI, automation, and reusable Crowe IP can standardize delivery, reduce effort, and increase margin — building prototypes, accelerators, and delivery patterns along the way, and growing a pipeline of hourly engagements converted into repeatable fixed\-fee or managed\-services offerings.
* Establish baseline measures for throughput, cycle time, rework, defects, escalations, and reuse, and drive measurable improvement against them.
* Support pre\-sales, solution shaping, estimation, technical workshops, and executive\-level discussions where needed.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Within your first year, you'll have:
   

  

* Raised the bar technically — the team is operating with clear architecture and engineering standards, and making sound, independent calls on ambiguous requirements and complex customer conversations across the Microsoft stack.
* Put reuse to work — the components, delivery patterns, and AI\-enabled workflows you've built are showing up across multiple engagements, not just the one they were built for, and cycle times and rework are visibly down as a result.
* Opened a new commercial path — you've turned multiple hourly engagements into repeatable fixed\-fee or managed\-services offerings, each with a real playbook behind it, and you're actively growing that pipeline.
* Grown people, not just projects — a handful of high\-potential engineers are visibly further along than when you started, and you've made the tough calls where someone wasn't the right fit.
* Earned trust as a technical voice — clients and colleagues come to you for the hard calls: when an AI agent is genuinely the right answer, and when the real fix is better data, a clearer process, or a simpler build.


**Required Experience**
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 5\+ years leading global engineering teams.
* Track record of mentoring engineers, setting technical standards, and helping teams adopt new delivery practices.
* Proven experience materially improving engineering team throughput, with measurable results achieved without simply adding headcount
* Hands\-on experience designing and shipping at least one production agentic or AI\-enabled solution — not just familiarity with the tools.
* Ability to design and explain end\-to\-end technical architectures across applications, data, automation, AI, security, and integration layers.
* Experience delivering in a consulting or professional\-services environment, comfortable with client\-facing, scoped engagements; exposure to shifting a delivery model from time\-and\-materials toward fixed\-fee or managed services is a strong plus.
* Strong understanding of business processes (e.g., customer service, sales, finance, operations, risk, compliance) and experience working directly with client stakeholders — business users, IT teams, architects, and senior leaders — owning those conversations rather than just supporting them.
* Strong hands\-on experience across the Microsoft stack — Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Azure (including Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search), Dataverse, Fabric, Logic Apps, Power Automate, APIs, and integration services.


**Mindset we need**
 This is not a role for a traditional developer who waits for requirements to be handed over. We need a forward\-deployed problem solver who can sit with a business team, understand how work actually happens, spot the broken handoffs and data gaps, and then engineer a practical solution — while also building that muscle in the team around them. They should be energized by being hands\-on and by making others better, not just by being right.
   

  

 Beyond that, we're looking for someone who:
   

  

* Has an automation mindset — the instinct is to eliminate the work, not just scale the number of people doing it.
* Communicates just as well in front of an engineering team as in front of a client's leadership, without needing two different vocabularies to do it.
* Takes ownership without waiting for permission and is willing to move before the path is fully clear.
* Has led through a real business transformation before — a change in how work actually gets done, not just a system migration.


 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
   

  

**Our Benefits:**
 At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
   

  

**How You Can Grow:**
 We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
   

  

**More about Crowe:**
 Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
   

  

 Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
   

  

 We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

* Create, maintain, and govern architecture artefacts including application landscapes, capability maps, integration diagrams, technology inventories, target\-state architectures, and Architecture Decision Records.
* Maintain and update enterprise architecture information within tools such as Ardoq, LeanIX, Bizzdesign, or equivalent repositories.
* Identify integration risks, technical debt, architectural gaps, dependencies, and operational impacts.
* Evaluate technology and application options based on business value, risk, dependencies, and M\&A integration requirements.
* Review solution designs and implementation plans for alignment with enterprise architecture principles and target\-state architecture.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, data, application, and business teams to develop integrated architecture solutions.
* Work with project teams and external partners to ensure successful execution of M\&A integration initiatives.

 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field

316e7c88.description:
**Description**
 ComPAS (Companion Products and Services) owns the third\-party (3P) accessories business that attaches to Amazon's device portfolio. Accessories and services help drive the devices flywheel by completing the customer experience and driving profitability across device families (Kindle, Fire, Echo, Ring, Blink, eero)
   

  

 We are hiring a Program Manager II, with worldwide scope, who is an expert in Amazon catalog, classification, and enforcement systems. This PM will own the 3P reclassification program end\-to\-end — writing and implementing the SOPs that reduce ASIN misclassification, managing seller enforcements, driving actionable insights in business reviews, and using AI\-skills to move the process from manual to automated. The role also supports 3P expansion into new device categories, starting with Ring, Blink, and eero.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the WW 3P classification program. Manage the process end\-to\-end across NA, EU and ROW regions. Write the SOPs and drive adoption with partner teams to improve classification at scale.
* Automate using AI and internal tooling. Reduce manual review by partnering with tech teams to apply AI/LLM\-based classification and workflow automation.
* Turn data into insight. Use existing dashboards to write WBR and QBR narratives. Translate the numbers into clear actions for the team and for senior leadership.
* Own enforcement. Write and operate the SOP for managing evasive sellers and bad actors in partnership with Seller Risk and Legal teams.
* Enable 3P expansion into new device categories. Starting with Ring, Blink, and eero, onboard new device families to the classification and reporting mechanisms.
* Raise the bar on mentoring and developing the best. Opportunity to mentor peer PMs, and grow with a fast\-scaling business.


**About The Team**
 Companion Products \& Services (ComPAS) owns the accessories and services ecosystem that surrounds Amazon's device portfolio, spanning across accessories, Extended Warranty, and the Pre\-Owned Business. Within ComPAS, the 3P Accessories \& Extended Warranty team's vision is to offer a world\-class selling experience for 3P selling partners growing their business on selection deemed exclusively compatible with Amazon Devices. We are a small, high\-ownership team with worldwide scope, moving fast and raising the bar on the mechanisms we build and the leaders we develop.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
